trg: Leslie Aun, muntu ketubilaka ya Fondation Komen, kutubaka nde kimvuka kundimaka kusadila mpila mosi ya mpa ya kubuya kupesa mbongo to bambongo na bimvuka na kusadila mpila ya kuzaba ya judiciaire.

src: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.
trg: Nsalulu ya Komen tulaka na lweka Mayela yina nkento na bakala ke salaka sambu na kuzwa kivumu yina Bo me kana ve na nima ya bansosa monisaka ti nsadilu yango vanda lomba mbongo mingi mutindu tubaka Ntumwa ya insi Cliff Stearns.

src: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.
trg: Stearns yo kele na kusosa kuzaba kana bampaku kele kepesama sambu na kupesa mbongo na kukatula badivumu na Planned Parenthood na kisalu na yandi ya mfumu ya sous-comité ya surveillance ti ya enquête, yayi kele kukambama na kimvuka ya énergie ti ya kisalu ya mumbongo.

src: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.
trg: Gouverneur ya Massachusetts ya ntama Mitt Romney nungaka na ba vote ya kimfumu ya insi ya Palati ya ba Republicain ya Floride na kilumbu ya zole kuluta Ntalu ya 46 ya ba vote.

src: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.
trg: Kinzonzi ya nzo ya Newt Gingrich ya ntete zwaka kisika ya zole na Ntalu 32%.

src: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.
trg: Mutindu muntu nungaka zwaka bwala yonso, Florida nungaka na bansaka tanu ya yandi na Romney, yina tulaka yandi na kisika ya ntete na vote ya Palati ya bana Republicain.

src: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.
trg: Bikubiki mambu ya kumangabansiku to lukanu tubaka ti bantu 100.000 yonzamaka na bambanza ya Allemagne mutindu Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg na Hanover.

src: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.
trg: Na Berlin, bapolisi tubaka ti bankolami vandaka kiteso ya 6 500.

src: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.
trg: Bo kolamaka mpi na Paris, na Sofia na Bulgarie, na Vilnius na Lituanie, na La Valette na Malte, na Tallinn na Estonie ti na Édimbourg ti Glasgow na Écosse.

src: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.
trg: Na Londres, bantu 200 songaka kukanga ya ntima ya bo na nganda ya ba Biro.

src: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.
trg: Ngonda me luta, bimangi mambu vandaka mingi na Pologne na ntangu insi tulaka kiniemo an ACTA, yina salaka ti mbula matadi ya Pologne kubaka lukanu ya ku tula ve kiniemo ya Bow na mukanda ya kuwakana, na ntangu beto ke na kuwakana.

src: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.
trg: Latvia na Slovakia bo yonso zole kumisaka nzila ya kukota na ACTA ntama.

src: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.
trg: Animal Liveration na Royal Society Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) kele bikunku zole yina nwanaka sambu na ba bika kutula bisadilu bibaki bizizi ya CCTV na bifuluyonso ba ke kufwaka ba ngombe ya Australie.

src: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.
trg: Mfumu kilongisi David O'Shannessy ya RSPCA Nouvelle Pays de Galles ya banda, tubaka lukengolo yaABC na kutala bifulu ya kufwa bambisi ke kuvanda kisika ya zabakana na Australie.

src: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."
trg: "CCTV zolaka kutina kidimbu ya ngolo na batu yina ya ke sala na Bambisi nde mambote ya nitu ke ya kuluta yonso na kutula na kisika ya ntete."

src: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.
trg: Carte ya anketi ya kunikana ya ntoto na bansi yonso ya Etats-Unis songaka kunikana ya ntoto ve na Iceland na mposo ya ntwala.

src: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.
trg: Biro ya météo ya Islande zabisaka kunikana ya ntoto mosi ve na bwala ya Hekla na bantangu 48 yai me luta.

src: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.
trg: Kunikana ya ngolo ya ntoto yina ya kwisaka kubasika na kubaluka na kitini ya ntete kusalamaka na kilumbu ya 10, ngonda ya tatu na ndambu ya nordi-esti ya nsongi ya volcan caldera.

src: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.
trg: Kikunku ya zulu ya ngumba ke talaka mambu ya bavolcan me tuba, kana matuti kele ndombeyo ke zabisaka ti volcan me kubasika.

src: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.
trg: Matuti ke songaka kiteso ya konda zaba mbote mbote kana tiya ya volcan basikaka to kubasikaka ve.

src: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.
trg: The Luno vandaka na ba metre kubwela tatu na 120 - 160 ya mafuta na ntangu yina yo bwaka na kitembo mpi ngolo ya masa nataka yo na kati ya masa.

src: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.
trg: Mipepe kupesa lufwa ve na bantu 12 na muntu mosi kaka me kuzwa mputa na mbombo ya yandi.

src: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.
trg: Maswa yina ya metre 100 vandaka kwenda baka cargo ya mafuku mpi na luyantiku bamfumu waka boma nde maswa bima ya ke na kati.

src: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.
trg: Nsoba ya mukanda basalaka me kutambula yimeni biniemo ya bikunku zolo na 2011.

src: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.
trg: Nsoba salamaka na mvukani ya Mimonisi bana ya bwala na yina nzo ya mvukani ya Mimonisi bana ya insi fwasaka nsokokono ya zole na kumisaka yo kifwani mosi nzo ya nzole ya luyalu na kilumbu ya ntete.

src: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.
trg: Kuzanga ya ndinga ya zole, yayi ketuba kubuya bakimvuka ya civiles homosexuelles, yo lenda kangula porte ya bakimvuka ya civiles na bilumbu kekwisa.

src: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.
trg: Na nima ya kusala kisalu yai, HJR-3 atat talula diaka mambu yina na bantuma ya ta ponama sambu na luyalu ya ke landa na 2015 to 2016 sambu na kubikala na kisalu.

src: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.
trg: Bisalu ya mansuka ya Vautier na nganda ya lutumu ya yandi kele na manaka ya kumanga kusala na mvula 1973 na ntwala yina yandi me kubinga kumanga dibanza ya bantu ya politiki.

src: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.
trg: nsiku ya bana falase sobaka. Bukindi ya yandi me katuka na bamvula 15 na tangu yandi buminaka Mvingu ya bafalase na ntangu ya Mvita ya zole yonzikaka makanda ya ntoto.

src: He documented himself in a 1998 book.
trg: Yandi zonzilaka yandi mosi na muku ya mvula 1998.

src: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.
trg: Na 1960 yandi vutukaka na Algerie yina zwaka kimpwanza ya mpa na kulongisa bantu mutindu ya kusala bafilme.

src: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.
trg: Kiyindumuki ya Zapo Hitoshi Saito, yina nungaka na nsaka ya Olympic ba medaille zole ya wolo, fwaka na mvula ya 54.

src: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.
trg: Kikuma ya lufwa na yandi vandaka maladi ya cancer.

src: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.
trg: Yandi fwaka na Osaka na kilumbu ya zole.

src: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.
trg: Mosi ya bachampion ya ntama ya olympiki ti mokili ya Mosi ya bachampion ya ntama ya olympiki ti mokili ya mvimba, Saito kuvandaka mfumu ya comité ya kulonga ya Fédération japonaise ya judo na ntangu ya lufwa na yandi.

src: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.
trg: Na fioti bantu 100 kwisaka na nkinzi yina, sambu na kukanina na lubutuku ya ntete ya bantu zole yai ya kwelaka mvula ya me luta.

src: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.
trg: Molulu mosi ya officiel ya anniversaire yolenglamaka na kilumbu mosi yayi ta kwisa mbasi, mbila bankwa makambu kutubaka.

src: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.
trg: Bantu zole yina kwelaka na Texas mvula mosi kuluta mpi bo kwisaka na Buffalo sambu na kuyangalala na banduku mpi bampangi.

src: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.
trg: Bakala ya kukwela ya bamvula 30 yina butukaka na Buffalo, vandaka mosi na bantu iya yina ba kubulaka kansi nkento lwalaka ata fyoti ve.

src: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.
trg: Karno kele longi ya Anglais ya me zabana mingi mpi ya ke basisaka ntembe mingi; yandi ke longisaka na universite ya bamvwama ya King Glory, na tubaka nde yandi vandaka ti bana ya nzo-nkanda kiteso 9000 ntangu yandi vandaka na lukumu.

src: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.
trg: Na kati ya mikanda na yandi, yandi sadilaka bandinga yayi babuti ya nkaka ke monaka bonso kukonda luzitu, mpi bo fundaka yandi nde yandi ke sadilaka ndinga ya mansoni na kati ya nzonkanda.

src: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.
trg: Education ya bubu yofundaka yandi sambu na kuimprime bapublicité na babisi na kuzanga kupesama nzila mpi ya kukusa na kutubaka nde ya vandaka ndongisi ya mbote ya Angleterre.

src: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.
trg: Yandi tambulaka lufundusu na nima kusonika buku yina vandaka ya yandi ve, kansi yandi mefutaka mbongo ve.

src: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'
trg: Longoki mosi ya ntama tubaka nde yandi vandaka 'kusadila kutuba ya mbi na nzo-nkanda, longaka mayele ya kusala banoti ya date, mpi vandaka kaka 'nduku' ya bana ya nzo-nkanda.

src: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.
trg: Na bamvula makumi tatu ya me luta, ata China me tombwisa ekonomi ya kuteka mpi kusumba, na meso ya bamfumu yo kele kaka insi ya communisme.

src: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.
trg: Bambongwana ya ntete ya kimumbongo yosalamaka na kukambama ya Deng Xiaoping.

src: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.
trg: Banda ntangu yina, nzangululu ya Chine me kuma na kiteso ya yinda na mbala 90.

src: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.
trg: Mbala ya ntete, mvula me luata Chine me sumba bakamio mingi kuluta Allemagne na me luta Amerika kele zandu ya nene na mambu me tadila bakamio.

src: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.
trg: PIB ya Chine lenda vanda na zulu kuluta ya Etats-Unis na bamvula makumi zole ya ke kwisa.

src: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.
trg: Mupepe ya ngolo ya bizunga ke nokaka mingi na zina ya Danielle, yina bame kubinga mupepe ya yiya na 2010 ya ntangu bangumba ya Atlantic, salamaka mpi na Ocean Atlantic ya este.

src: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).
trg: Kitembo ya nene, yina me talana na bitini 3 000 ya ba mile katuka na Miami, Floride, ke nata mipepe ya ntinu ya 40 mph (64 kph).

src: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.
trg: Bantu ya siansi ya kimvuka National Hurricane Center, ke tuba nde Danielle ta kuma ngolo mpi yo ta kuma ouragan na Kitatu.

src: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.
trg: Yina kitembo ke ya kutatuka na ntoto, ya kele mpasi na ku zaba mvwanzi yina yo lenda nata na Amerika to Kalayibi.

src: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.
trg: Yandi butukaka na Zagreb, bwala kimfumu ya Croatie, Bobek bakaka lukumu ntangu yandi vandaka kubula nkweso na Partizan Belgrade.

src: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.
trg: Yandi landaka bo na 1945 mpi ya bikalaka tiii na 1958.

src: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.
trg: Na ntangu na yandi na ekipi, yandi tulaka makonga 403 na bansaka 468.

src: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.
trg: Muntu ve talanaka to lulaka makongo ya mingi na kinkuku ya nsaka ya balo kulutila Bobek.

src: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.
trg: Na 1995, ya ponamaka bonso joueur mosi ya histoire ya Partizan.

src: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.
trg: Bo fwete mebanda na spectacle spécial ya kimvuka ya mezabana ntoto mvimba Cirque du Soleil.

src: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.
trg: Yo landamaka na Kimvuka ya bantu ya ke yimbaka ya symphonie ya Istanbul, kimvuka mosi ya bantu ya ke yimbaka ya janissaire ti bantu ya ke yimbaka ya Fatih Erkoç ti Müslüm Gürses.

src: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.
trg: Na nima ya Whiring Dervishes mataka na scene.

src: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.
trg: Mumbi ya Turquie Sezen Aksu yimbaka kumosti ti mumbi ya tenor ya Italie lessandro Safina mpi muymbi ya Grece Haris Alexiou.

src: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".
trg: Sambu na kumanisa, kimvuka ya makinu ya Turke Fire ya Anatolia yo songaka makinu ya "Troy".

src: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
trg: Peter Lenza, mwana ya bamvula 13 kikimi ntinu ya kiviangu viangu, zwaka lufwa na nima ya kusala aksida na nsaka Indianapoli Motor Seedway.

src: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.
trg: Na ntangu na yandi ya kuyilama sambu nitu kuyilama, Lenz bwaka na velo na yandi, mpi tutanaka na mpangi na yandi munati velo, Xavier Zayat.

src: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.
trg: Bo bakaka yandi na lusadisu ya baminganga mpi bo nataka yandi na lopitalo mosi ya bwala wapi yandi fwaka.

src: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.
trg: Zayat lwalaka ve na aksida.

src: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.
trg: Na yai ke tala dikambu ya mbongo na ntoto ya mvimba, Zapatero ya landaka na kutuba nde "systeme ya mumbongo kele na kati ya économie, kitini mosi ya mfunu mingi.

src: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."
trg: Beto kele na mpasi ya mbongo ya mvula mosi, yina ya kwisaka kukuma ngolo ngonda zole yai ya me luta, mpi mu ke banza nde sasaipi yai bazandu ya mbongo ke banda kukuma mbote."

src: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.
trg: Mposo ya nima, Naked News kuzabisaka nde bo ta yika na mutindu ya kuyituka bandinga ya insi ya mvimba ya me pesama nswa ya kupanza nsangu, na manaka tatu ya kupanza nsangu.

src: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.
trg: Na nima ya ku sadila bandinga ya kingelezo pe kizaponi, kikunku ya global me ku kutula na nkanda ya bantu yonso ba ndinga ya sipanole, Italie mpi kolea na malakisi ya bo, na bizizi, na kondé to internet mpi na ba telefone.

src: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.
trg: Kima ve zwaka munu, kansi mu talaka mambu ya mbi, bantu zolaka ku basula fenetele sambu bo kubasika.

src: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.
trg: Bantu vandaka kubula batalatala na bakiti, kansi madidisi vandaka kupanzana ve.

src: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.
trg: "Mosi ya bitalatala na nsuka yo pasukaka bobandaka kubasika na bafenetre" mpi ya muntu mosi kutubaka ya Franciszek Kowal.

src: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.
trg: Bambwetete ke pesaka nsemo ti tiya sambu na ngolo ya me tulama ntangu biteni ya hydrogene me vukana na kisika mosi sambu na kusama bima ya kizitu.

src: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.
trg: Bantu ya kizabu ke na kusala sambu na kutunga motele ke kupesa ngolo na nzila mosi.

src: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.
trg: Kansi yai kele diambu ya nene na kubongisa mpi ta baka mvula mingi na ntwala ya beto kumona ba reacteurs mingi kusalama.

src: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.
trg: Ntumbu ya kibende ke tambulaka na zulu ya masa sambu na ngolo ya zulu ya masa.

src: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.
trg: Muvuzi ya bantu ke bandaka sambu ba molécule ya masa na zulu ya masa yokesanganaka sambu yo kele ba molecule ya mupepe ve yayi ke vandaka na zulu na yo mosi.

src: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.
trg: Bamolécules ya masa ke salaka mpusu mosi yayi ke monanaka ve na zulu ya masa ya ke pesaka nzila na bima bonso sindani kutepatepa na zulu ya masa.

src: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.
trg: Meno ya lutebo ya kuzenga glace ya mpa ke na meno ya ndambu zole na dibulu na katikati. Meno yina ke pesa nzila ya kusimba glace mbote, ata kana yo ke ya kunyekama.

src: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.
trg: Sambu na insi ya lutebo yo kele ya kufinika, kana lutebo me finuka na nsongi mosi to na nsongi ya nkaka, pembeni na yo yayi kele na glace yo ke fuinuka mpi.

src: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.
trg: Yo kesalaka nde pine kubaluka. Kana pine kebalukaka na diboko ya bakala, pine tabaluka na diboko ya nkento.

src: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
trg: Na kuvutuka na kitambi ya yandi ya enelezi ya ngolo, bo fwete kuzimbana enelezi ya kulutila yina bo me kuzwa na kula.

src: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
trg: Bokesalaka yo na kutinda mwa ndambu ya mwinda yayi bokebingaka "photon".

src: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
trg: Bantu ya siansi ke bingaka nsadilu yayi, kupesa ngolo na mbutulu ya radiation to "stimuler l'emission de radiation" sambu na mwina ya nsamina mingi ke pesaka ngolo na ba atome, na ke pesaka mbutulu ya mwinda ya photon na mwinda na mutindu ya radiation.

src: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
trg: kizizi ya nkaka ke na kusonga atome me kubasisa photon. Na kedika, photon me kulutila fyoti na yina bizizi ke na kusonga.

src: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
trg: Baphoton kele fioti kibeni kuluta bima yina ke salaka atome!

src: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.
trg: Na nima ya kusala bangunga mingi, nsukansuka nsinga ya ampoule ke fwaka mpi ampoule ke salaka diaka ve.

src: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.
trg: Yo ke lomba kutula ampoule ya nkaka. Beno fwete sala keba na ntangu ya kutula ampoule ya nkaka.

src: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.
trg: Ya ntete, kana beno zola kuvula kula, beno fwana kufwa kisadilu to kukwabula singa.

src: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.
trg: Yo ke sambu na kula yina lutaka na kati ya douille kisika kibende mpi lenda pesa nge chock ya kula kana nge me kusimba yo na kati ya douille to kibende ke na mwinda yina ke ntete na douille.

src: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.
trg: Ntima kele kinama ya nkinzi na nzutu ya muntu, na yina yandi ke fidisaka menga na ngolo na binama ya nzutu nyonso.

src: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.
trg: Menga ke basikaka na ntima na minoko ya bo ke bingaka Artere mpi ke vutuka na ntima na minoko ya fioti-fioti yina ya bo ke binga "veins". Ya minoko ya fioti kuluta bo ke bingaka yo ba "capillares".

src: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.
trg: Meno ya triceratoplenda ke pasulaka kaka ve matiti kansi yo ke pasulaka mpi balutangu na misisa.

src: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.
trg: Bantu ya nkaka ya siansi ke yindulaka nde Triceratops vandaka kudia ba cycas, yina kele mutindu mosi ya nti yina vandaka mingi na na Crétacé.

src: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.
trg: Banti yai ke vandaka bonso maba ya fioti, ti mpu ya bansende mpi ya ke bonso mbele.

src: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.
trg: Ndeke na zina ya Triceratops ke sadilaka munoko na yandi ya ngolo sambu na kukatula matiti na ntwala yandi kudya nti.

src: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
trg: Bantu ya ya nkaka ya siansi ke tubaka nde banti yai ke mpenza ndikila mpi yo kele kieleka ve nde badinozore vandaka kudia yo, ata kana bubu yayi kikoti (mbisi ya mfinda ya goyi-goyi mpi bambisi ya nkaka bonso tsiaku (kilandi ya badinozore) lenda kudia matiti to mbuma ya ndikila.

src: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.
trg: Inki mutindu ngolo ya ntoto ya ke bendaka bantu lenda benga mu? Kana nge me telama na kisika ya zulu, nge ta vanda na kilo fioti kana nge kele na Ntoto.

src: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.
trg: Muntu ya kele ti ba ppounds 200 (90 kg) na Ntoto ta vanda ti ba pounds kiteso ya 36 (16kg) na zulu. Ngolo ya ntoto ya ke bendaka bantu ta vanda ve ti bupusi mingi na nge.

src: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.
trg: Ntangu ke vandaka ve ti kisika ngolo yina nge lenda telama bonso Ntoto. Ntangu ya mbima me salama na mupepe, tiya mpi plazma.

src: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.
trg: Mupepe ke kumaka fioti kana nge ke kwenda ntama pene-pene ya Ntangu.

src: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".
trg: Ndambu ya nganda ya beto ke monaka ntangu beto ke tala Ntangu, bo ke bingaka yo photosphere, yina ke te tendula "ballon ya nsemo".

src: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.
trg: Kiteso ya mafunda ya bamvula tatu na nima, na 1610, Astronome ya Italie Galileo Galilei sadilaka telescope sambu na kumona nde Venus kele na ba phases/nsungi kaka bonso ngonda.

src: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.
trg: Bansungi ke salamaka sambu kaka lweka ya Venus (to ya Ngonda) ya ke talaka Ntangu ke vandaka na nsemo. Bansungi ya Venus ke nungisaka dilongi ya Copernicus ya ke tubaka nde baplanete ke tambulaka na nziunga ya Ntangu.

src: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.
trg: Ebuna, mwa bamvula na nima na 1639, astrome mosi ya Angleterre, zina na yandi Jeremiah Horrock monaka kutambula na Venus.

src: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.
trg: Angleterre vandaka na nsungi ya nda ya ngemba na niima ya kubotula diaka Danelaw.

src: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.
trg: Kansi, na 991, Ethelred nwanaka ti maswa ya basoda ya nene kibeni ya Vikingi kuluta knso Guthrum mvu-nkama mosi me luta.

src: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.
trg: Muntu vandaka kutwadisa maswa yina kele Olaf Trygvasson, mwana ya Norvege yina vandaka ti nzala ya ngolo ya kubotula insi yina na luyalu ya bana ya Danemark.

src: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.
trg: Na nima ya kukonda kununga ya bamakesa ya ntete, Ethelred ndimaka kuwakana ti Olaf, yina vutukaka na Norvège sambu na kumeka kubaka diaka kimfumu na yandi kansi yandi nungakampenza ve.

src: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).
trg: Hangeul ke muntu mosi yina gangaka alfabe sambu bantu yonso kusadila yo. Bo salaka alfabe na 1444 na ntangu ya luyalu ya Ntotila Sejong (1418 – 1450).

src: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.
trg: Ntotila Sejong vandaka mfumu ya iya ya kimfumu ya Joseon mpi mosi ya bamfumu yina zabanaka mingi.

src: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".
trg: Yandi pesaka ntete alfabe ya Hangeul zina Hunmin Jeongeum, yina ke tendula "mingungu ya mbote sambu na kulonga bantu".

src: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
trg: Kele ti malongi mingi ya ke tubila mutindu bo gangaka ndinga ya Sanscrit. Mosi na yo ke tubila mutindu bantu ya Aryan yina katukaka na ouest mpi kwisaka na Inde, mpi bo kwisaka ti ndinda na bo.

src: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
trg: Sanskrit kele ndinga ya ntama mpi yo me fwanana ti ndinga ya Latin yina bo ke tubaka na Eropa.

src: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
trg: Bo sonikaka mukanda ya ntama mingi ya me zabanaka na ntoto ya mvimba na Sanskrit. Na nima ya kuvukisa Upanishads, Sanskrit vandaka diaka na mfunu ve sambu yo kumaka ya ntama.

src: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
trg: Sanskrit kele ndinga mosi ya mpasi mpi ya kele ti bangogo mingi; yo me sadisaka na kusala bandinga mingi ya Inde ya bubu, kaka mutindu Latin kele ndinga ya kisika ya bandinga mingi ya Eropa mu mbandu Français na Espagnole.

src: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.
trg: Awa ya mvita ya France manaka, Allemagne yantikaka kukotila kisanga ya Angleterre.

src: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.
trg: Allemagne pesaka bitumba yina zina "Kinwana ya Sealion". Minduki mingi ya ngolo ya Angleterre mpi binwaninu na bo vilaka ntangu bo basikaka na Bunkirt, yo yina basoda vandaka mpenza ve ngolo.

src: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.
trg: Kansi Royal Navy kuvandaka ngolo mingi kuluta Marine ya ba Allemand ("Kriegsmarine") mpi yo lendaka kubebisa bamaswa yonso ya bo tindaka na Manche.

src: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
trg: Kansi, bamaswa ya Royal Navy fioti mpamba vandaka pene-pene ya banzila ya kukota sambu na kukwenda kunwana sambu bo vandaka kuwa boma nde basoda ya Allemagne ta dindisa bo.

src: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.
trg: Bika beto banda na kutendula bangindu ya Italie. Italie vandaka mingi-mingi "leke ya bakala" ya Allemange mpi ya Japon.

src: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.
trg: Yo vandaka na basoda ya ngolo ve mpi maswa ya basoda yangolo, kansi bo katukaka kusala bamaswa iya ya mpa na ntwala nde bitumba kuyantika.

src: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.
trg: Balukanu ya nene ya Italie vandaka bansi ya Afrika. Sambu na kubotula bansi yina, yo lombaka bo vanda ti kimvuka ya basoda, yo yina basoda lendaka kusabuka Nzadi-mungwa ya Mediterane mpi kobotula Afrika.

src: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.
trg: Sambu na kusala yo, yo lombaka bo katula ba camp mpi bamaswa ya Angleterre na Egypte. Katula mambu yina, yo vandaka kulomba ve nde bamaswa ya bituma ya Italie kusala kima ya nkaka.

src: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.
trg: Sesepi sambu na Japon. Japon vandaka ntoto yina vandaka na kati ya bisanga, kaka bonso Grande Bretagne.

src: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.
trg: Sous-marins kele maswa ya bo me salaka sambu yo tambula na nsi ya masa, mpi kubikala kuna na nsi sambu na kitamina ya ntangu mingi.

src: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.
trg: Bo sadilaka ba sous-marins na Bitumba ya Ntete mpi ya Zole ya Ntoto ya Mvimba. Na ntangu yina, yo vandaka malembe mpi yo vandaka kubula masasi ntama ve.

src: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.
trg: Na luyantiku ya mvita, bo vandaka kusala nzietelo mbala mingi na zulu ya nzadi-mungwa, kansi ntangu bo yantikaka kusala radare mpi yo vandaka kusadisa mingi, ba sous-marins kumaka kukwenda na nsi ya masa sambu bo mona bo ve.

src: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.
trg: Bo vandaka kubinga ba sous-marins ya Allemagne U-Boats. Bantu ya Allemagne zabaka mbote kutambula na masa mpi kutwadisa bamaswa na bo ya bitumba.

src: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
trg: Sambu bo nungaka na ba sous-marins na bo, na nima ya bitumba, bantu vandaka kundima ve nde Allemagne vandaka ti yo mingi.

src: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.
trg: Yinga! Bantangu ya nkaka, yina bo ke bingaka Ntotila Tutankhamun, "Nttotila Tut" to "Ntotila ya leke", kele mosi ya bantotila ya Egypte ya ntama yina me zabanaka mingi bubu yai.

src: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.
trg: Dikambu ya mfunu mingi, bo vandaka kumona yandi ve bonso muntu ya mfunu na ntangu ya ntama mpi bo me sonikaka ve zina na yandi na baliste mingi ya bantotila ya ntama.

src: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.
trg: Kansi, kumonana ya maziamu na yandi na 1922 salaka nde yandi zabana. Ata bamaziamu mingi ya ntangu ya ntama bo me yibaka yo, maziamu na yandi kele kibeni kaka mutindu yo vandaka.

src: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.
trg: Bima mingi yina bo zikaka kumosi ti Toutankhamon, bo me bumbaka yo mbote, ata mpi mafunda ya bima ya mfunu yina bo salaka na matadi ya ntalu mpi ya ke monanaka mingi ve.

src: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.
trg: Kusala bapneu sadisaka bantu ya Asiria na kusala bapusu-pusu ya pete, ya ntinu mingi mpi na kudibongisa mbote sambu na kubaka ntinu kuluta basoda mpi bapusu-pusu ya nkaka.

src: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.
trg: Batolo-tolo ya ke katuka na binwaninu na yo ya ngolo lendaka na binwaninu ya basoda ya bambeni. Pene-pene ya mvu 1000 na ntwala ya ntangu na beto, bantu ya Asiria basisaka basoda ya ntete ya ke nwanaka na mpunda.

src: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.
trg: Cavalier kele sonda yina ke nwanaka na zulu ya mpunda. Bo salaka ntete ve kisika ya kuvanda, yo yina ba cavalier ya Asiria vandaka kunwana kaka mutindu yina na mukongo ya bampunda na bo.

src: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.
trg: Beto me zaba bantu ya Grece mingi ya politiki, ya siansi, mpi ya ke sonikaka. Mbala ya nkaka muntu ya me zabanaka mingi kele Homer, poete mosi ya kifwa-meso, yina sonikaka masolo zole ya kitoko mingi ya masolo ya Grece: poeme ya Iliad na ya Odyssey.

src: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.
trg: Sophocles na Aristophanes kele bansoniki ya me zabana mingi mpi bima na bo ke vandaka na kati ya masolo ya mfunu mingi ya bo me sonikaka.

src: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.
trg: Muntu ya nkaka ya Grece ya me zabanaka kele muntu ya mathematique Pytagore, yina me zabana mingi sambu na dilongi na yandi ya me tala kuwakana ya bansongi ya triangles rectangles.

src: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.
trg: Yo kele ti bantalu ya kuswaswana ya bantu yina ke tubaka ndinga ya Hindi. Bo ke tubaka nde yo fwete vanda ndinga ya zole to ya iya ya bantu ke tubaka mingi na ntoto ya mvimba.

src: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.
trg: Ntalu ya bantu ya ke tuba ndinga yina me swaswana kana beto ke tanga to ve bandinga ya fioti ya ke wakana ti yo.

src: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.
trg: Bo ke tubaka nde bantu na kat iya bamilio 340 mpi 500 ke tubaka yo, mpi bantu bamilio 800 lenda bakisa ndinga yango.

src: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
trg: Bandinga Hindi na Urdu ke mutindu mosi na bangogo kansi bo ke sonikaka mutindu mosi ve; na masolo ya konso kilumbu, bantu ya ke tubaka bandinga yonso zole lenda solula mbote konso mpasi.

src: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
trg: Pene-pene ya mvu-nkama ya 15, norde ya Estonie vandaka na nsi ya bupusi mingi ya kinkulu ya Allemagne.

src: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
trg: Bamoine ya nkaka ya Allemagne vandaka kuzola kubenda bankwa-bwala pene-pene na Nzambi, yo yina bo gangaka ndinga ya Estonie.

src: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
trg: Yo salamaka na alafabe ya bantu ya Allemagne na bo yikaka kisono mosi "Õ/õ".

src: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
trg: Na nima, bangogo mingi yina bo bakaka na ndinga ya Allemagne vukanaka. Yo vandaka luuantiku ya kutemuna.

src: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.
trg: Na kulanda kinkulu, muntu yina ke baka kiti ya kimfumu fwete sala ntete kisalu ya kisoda na nima ya kumanisa nzo-nkanda.

src: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).
trg: Kansi, Charles kwendaka na iniversite ya Trinity College, na Cambridge, kisika yandi longukaka Anthropologie mpi archeologie, mpi na nima masolo ya ntama, yandi bakaka matonsi ya 2:2 (dipolome ya fioti ya nzo-nkanda ya zole).

src: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.
trg: Charles vandaka muntu ya ntete ya dikanda ya Kimfumu ya Grande Bretagne na kuzwa Diplome.

src: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.
trg: Turquie ya Europa ( Thrace ya Este to Rumelia na kisanga ya Balkan) kele 3% ya insi yai.

src: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.
trg: Teritware ya Turquie kele bakilometre kuluta 1600 (1000 miles) na nda ti 800 km (500 miles) na nene, mpi yo kele bonso rectangle.

src: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.
trg: Nene ya Turquie, ti balake, kele ya bakilometre carrés 783 562 (300 948 milles carrés), mpi 755 688 ya bakilometre carrés (291 773 milles carrés) na Azie ya sud-ouest ti bakilometre carrés 23 764 (9174 milles carrés) na Europe.

src: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.
trg: Nene ya Turquie ke salaka nde yo vanda nsi ya 37 ya kuluta nene na ntoto ya mvimba, mpi nene yina ke vukisa France ya mvimba na Royaume Uni.

src: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.
trg: Turquie me ziungama na banzadi-mungwa na bandambu tatu: Nzadi-Mungwa Egee na weste, Nzadi-Mungwa ya ndombe na norde mpi Nzadi-Mungwa Mediteranea na sude.

src: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.
trg: Luxembourg kele na disolo ya ntama kansi yo bakaka impwanza banda na mvu 1839.

src: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.
trg: Bitini ya Belgique ya bubu yai vandaka ntete na kati ya Luxembourg na ntangu ya ntama kansi yo kumaka ya Belgique na nima ya Revolution ya Belgique ya 1830.

src: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.
trg: Luxembourg ke mekaka ntangu yonso na kukota ve na mavwanga ya bansi kasi Allemagne botulaka yo na Mvita ya Ntete mpi ya Zole ya Ntoto ya Mvimba.

src: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.
trg: Na 1957, Luxembourg kumaka na kati ya makanda yina salaka kimvuka yina beto ke bingaka bubu yai Union européenne.

src: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).
trg: Drukgyal Dzong kele nzo ya ngolo ya kubeba mpi yo kele monastère ya bantu ya Budha na kitini ya zulu ya istrike Pero (na bwala Phondey).

src: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.
trg: Bantu ke tubaka nde na 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel salaka kisika ya ngolo sambu na kuyibuka mutindu yandi nungaka baosa ya Mongolie ya Tibetain.

src: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
trg: Na mvula 1951, tiya salaka nde ndambu mpamba ya bima ya ntama ya Drukgyal Dzong kubikala, mu mbandu kifwani ya Zhabdrung Ngamang Namgyal.

src: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.
trg: Na nima ya tiya, bo taninaka kisika yina ya ngolo, mpi yo kele mosi ya bima ya kitoko kibeni ya Buthan.

src: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.
trg: Na mvu-nkama ya 18, Cambodge kangamaka na kati na baluyalu zole ya ngolo, Thailande mpi Vietnam.

src: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.
trg: Bant ya Thailande kotaka na ngolo na Cambodge mbala mingi na mvu-nkama ya 18 mpi na 1772, bo fwaka Phnom Phen.

src: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.
trg: Na bamvula ya nsuka ya mvu-nkama ya 18, bantu ya Vietnam kotaka diaka na ngolo na Cambodge.

src: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.
trg: Bant ya Venezwela 18% ke vandaka ve ti kisalu, mpi mingi ya kati ya bayina ke na bisalu ke salaka bisalu ya mumbongo ya bo mosi.

src: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.
trg: Bantu ya Venezuela zole na kati ya tatu yina ke salaka bisalu ya bo mosi, kiteso ya mosi na kati ya iya ke salaka na ba kompani mpi kiteso ya mosi na kati ya tanu ke salaka kisalu ya bilanga.

src: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.
trg: Kisalu ya mfunu mingi sambu na bantu ya Venezuela kele petrole, wapi insi yai kele mosi ya ke tekaka yo na nganda, ata kaka muntu mosi na nkama ke salaka na bisalu ya petrole.

src: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.
trg: Na luyantiku ya kimpwanza ya bwala, mayele ya bilanga ya bantu ya Singapour sadisaka yo na kukumisa kisanga yina Mbanza ya Kitoko ya kele ti masamba.

src: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.
trg: Na 1981, bo ponaka Vanda Miss Joaquim, kintuntu ya kubutukaka na kuvukisa banti ya nkaka, bonso kintuntu ya insi.

src: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.
trg: Konso mvula na Octobre bambisi ya ke diaka matiti kiteso ya bamilio1,5 ke kwendaka na banseke ya sude, bo ke sabukaka Nzadi mara, bo ke katulaka na bisika ya bangumbaya norde, bo ke kwendaka kuvingila bamvula.

src: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.
trg: Bo ke lutaka na weste sambu na kuvutuka na norde, diaka bo ke sabukaka nzadi Mara, na nima ya bamvula ya ngonda ya Avril.

src: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.
trg: Provense ya Serengeti kele na parc national ya Serengeti, kisika ya kubumba bima ya ya Ngorongoro ti réserve ya gibier ya Maswa na Tanzanie ti réserve nationale ya Maasai Mara na Kenya.

src: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)
trg: Kulonguka na kusala médias interactifs ke lombaka kusadila mayele ya mbote mpi ya ntama, mpi bisadilu ya mbote na nzo-nkanda (storyboarding, kusadila bima ya kuwidikila mpi bavideo, kuta masolo, mpi ya nkaka.)

src: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.
trg: Bima ya interactifs ke lombaka nge tadila diaka mayele na nge na yina me tala kusala ba media mpi kulonguka na kuyindla na nzila kaka mosi ve.

src: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.
trg: Bima ya interactifs ke lombaka nde bima ya kisalu mosi kuwakana na kati na yo, kasi mpi yo vandaka mfunu kana yo kele yo mosi.

src: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.
trg: Mbi ya luneti ya kumona kele nde kisika ya kutala kele mpasi mpi ntalu ya bima ya bo me sadila ke lombaka kutala batalala mingi mpi yo kele mingi kuluta manete ya bo ke sadilaka ntete.

src: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.
trg: Yo kele diaka ve diambu ya mpasi sambu bantu ya ke salaka baneti ke lungisaka minsiku ya nene ntangu bo ke salaka maneti.

src: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.
trg: Yo me pesaka nzila na bitalulu ya nene sambu na kusala bifwanisu ya kitoko mingi kuluta yina beto lenda sala na bitalatala ya ke nikanaka ve.

src: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.
trg: Mpasi ya nkaka ya bitalatala kele nde vitese (ntinu) ya nene ya zoom ke vandaka mbala mingi ya fioti.

src: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.
trg: Yo ke salaka zoom ya ntalu fioti kuvanda mpasi na kusadila na bisika ya mpasi kana flashe kele ve.

src: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.
trg: Mosi ya dikambu ya ntangu nyonso na ntangu nge ke meka kukumisa filme na format ya DVD kele ya kusala overscan.

src: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.
trg: Bo ke salaka batelevizio mingi sambu na kusepdisa bantu yina ke tala.

src: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.
trg: Sambu na kikuma yina, bima nyonso ya nge ke monaka na TV vandaka na mipanzi ya kuzenga, zulu, nsi mpi balweka.

src: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.
trg: Bo ke salaka yo sambu na bizuzi kufuluka na ecran. Bo ke bingaka overscan.

src: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.
trg: Kansi yo kele mawa, ntangu nge ke sala DVD, yo ta lomba mpi kuzenga bandilu na yo, ebuna kana video kele ti bisono yina kele pene-pene ya bansuka, yo ta monana ve mbote.

src: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.
trg: Château médiéval ya ntama me sadisaka banda ntama na kuyindula, na kupesa kifwanisu ya bansaka ya kunwana, ya bafeti mpi ya chevalerie Arthurienne.

src: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.
trg: Ata yo kele ya kutelema na kati ya ntangu ya mbi, yo kele pete ya kuyibusa bandinga na bansudi ya bamvita yayi me salamaka banda ntama, mpi na kuwa makelele ya sabo na pavé ti kuwa boma ya ke katuka na mabengi ya donjon.

src: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?
trg: Kansi ngindu na beto kele kaka ya masonga? Sambu na nki châteaux kutungamaka na kisika ya ntete? Nki mpila bo salaka plan na yo mpi bo tungaka yo?

src: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.
trg: Nzo ya nene ya ya ntangu yina, Kirby Muxloe kele nzo ya ngolo kansi ve chateaux ya kieleka.

src: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.
trg: Bafenetre na yo ya nene mpi bibaka na yo ya fioti lendaka ve kubikala kana bo nwanisaka yo na ntangu mingi.

src: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.
trg: Na bamvu 1480, ntangu Lord Hastings yantikaka kutunga yo, insi vandaka na ngemba mpi bo vandaka kutanina yo kaka na mwa bimvuka ya fioti ya miyibi.

src: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.
trg: Kukabula kiyeka kele ngidika yina ke sadisaka makanda ya Europa na kiyeka ya konso luyalu na makanda yonso ya Europa.

src: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.
trg: Ngindu vandaka nde bansi yonso ya Europa fwete sosa na kubuya nde insi mosi kukuma ngolo, mpi mpidina bambula-matari ya bansi sobaka kuwakana na bo sambu na kutanina bukatikati yina.

src: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.
trg: Bitumba ya kuyala ya Espagne vandaka bitumba ya ntete yina kikuma na yo vandaka bukatikati ya kiyeka.

src: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.
trg: Yo vandaka nsoba ya nene, sambu makana Europa vandaka diaka ve ti mfunu ya kusadila mvita ya lusambu sambu na kunwanina kiyeka. Yo yina, Mvita ya Bamvula Makumi Tatu vandaka mvita ya nsuka ya bo bingaka mvia ya mabundu.

src: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.
trg: Bo fwaka tempelo ya Artemis na Efezo na le 21 juillet, 356 na ntwala ya ntangu na beto, na Herostratus na diambu ya nku yina yandi salaka.

src: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.
trg: Na kutala masolo ya ntama, kima pusaka yandi na kusala yo vandaka lukumu. Bantu ya Efezo yina waka makasi, tubaka nde bo fwete sonika ve zina ya Herostratus na mikanda.

src: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.
trg: Na nima, Strabo, muntu ya Grèce ke tubilaka masolo ya ntama sonikaka zina na yandi, yina mutindu beto me zabaka yo bubu yai. Bo fwaka tempelo na mpimpa yina Alexandre ya Nene butukaka.

src: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
trg: Alexandre, yina vandaka ntotila, pesaka dikabu ya mbongo sambu na kutunga diaka tempelo yina, kansi bo byaka yo, Na nima ya lufwa ya Alexandre, bo tubaka diaka tempelo yina na mvu 323 na ntwala ya ntangu an beto.

src: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.
trg: Zikisa nde diboko na nge kele ya kulemba ntangu nge ke landa kubula banoti yonso mbote-mbote - diaka meka kusala ve bidimbu ya ngolo na maboko ya nge.

src: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.
trg: Na mpila yai, nge ta lemba mpenza ve. Kuvila ve nde mfunu kele ve ya kubula na zulu ya babuton na ngolo yonso sambu na kubaka volume ya nkaka, bonso na piano.

src: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.
trg: Na zulu ya accordéon, sambu na kubaka ndinga ya ngolo, nge few sadila soufflet na ngolo yonso to vitesse.

src: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.
trg: Kusala mambu ya mystique kele kulanda kuvanda na bumosi na, kubaka zina, kuzaba na mutindu ya kuzola na kieleka, bunzambi, kieleka ya kimpeve, to Nzambi.

src: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.
trg: Muntu ya ke kwikila ke sosaka kuzaba ya mbala mosi, ngindu to kumona ya masonga ya nzambi to banzambi ya babakala to ya bankento.

src: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.
trg: Balongoki ke landaka mitindu mosi buna ya luzingu, to bikalulu ya ke sadisaka na kuyedisa mayele yina.

src: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.
trg: Beto lenda fwanisa mysticisme na mitindu ya nkaka ya balukwikilu mpi lusambu sambu yo ke tulaka dikebi mingi na mambu ya muntu yandi mosi ke kutana ti yo na ntangu yandi ke zaba mambu, mingi-mingi ngemba, mayele, lusakumunu, to nkutu kutuntumuka.

src: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
trg: Sikhiism kele dibundu ya kusadila nzambi katuka na Inde ya bwala. Yo bandaka na provense ya ya Punjab na mvu-nkama ya 15 katuka na kukabwana ya malongi ya Hindu.

src: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
trg: Ba sikhs ke monaka nde lukwikilu na bo ke ya kukabwana na kimvuka ya bisambu ya Hindou ata bo ke ndimaka nde yo katukaka na Hindou mpi na binkulu na yo.

src: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
trg: Ba Sikhs vandaka kubinga dibundu na bo Gurmat, yina kele Punjabi na "nzila ya guru". Guru kele kima ya mfunu mingi na mabundu yonso ya Inde kansi na Sihisme yo me bakaka kisika yina ke salaka nde yo vandaka na mfunu mingi kuluta na balukwikilu na bo.

src: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
trg: Bo salaka dibundu na mvu-nkama ya 15 na Guru Nanak (1469-1539). Na nima bagurus uvwa bakaka kimfumu.

src: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.
trg: Kansi, na juin 1956, bantu teleminaka balusilu ya Krushchev ntangu mubulu basikaka na Pologne sambu bantu mingi ya kisalu vandaka kutelamina kukonda madia mpi kukulumusa salere, yo kumaka mavwanga ya ngolo sambu na bantu ya Communisme.

src: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.
trg: Ata na nsuka, Krushchev tindaka ba blinde sambu na kuvutula ngemba, yandi ndimaka mwa mambu ya mbongo mpi ndimaka kutula Wladyslaw Gomulka yina bantu vandaka kuzola mingi, premier ministre.

src: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.
trg: Civilisation ya Muwanda ya Indus vandaka civilisation ya Nsungi ya bronze na sous-continent ya Inde ya nord-ouest; yo vukisaka kitini ya nene ya Pakistan ya bubu mpi bitini ya nkaka ya nord-ouest ya Inde ti ya nord-est ya Afghanistan.

src: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.
trg: Civilisation tomaka na bisika ya pene-pene ya Nzadi Indus kisika wapi yo bakaka zina na yo.

src: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.
trg: Ata bantu ya mayele ya nkaka ke yindulaka nde sambu civilisation vandaka mpi na kisika yina kele ntangu yai Nzadi ya Kuyuma ya Sarasvati, beto fwete binga yo mpenza nde Civilisation ya Inde Sarasvati, kansi bankaka ke bingaka yo Civilisation ya Harappa na zina ya Harrapa, mosi ya bifulu na yo ya ntete ya bo timunaka na bamvu 1920.

src: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
trg: Mutindu kimfumu ya Roma vandaka kuzola bitumba sadisaka na kubasisa mambu ya mpa ya kimunganga.

src: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
trg: Bntotila Auguste yantikaka kubaka minganga na kisalu mpi yandi salaka nkutu Kimvuka ya Ntete ya Minganga ya Roma sambu na kusadila bo na nima ya bitumba.

src: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
trg: Minganga ya ke salaka operation zabaka bankisi mingi ya ke lembikaka mpasi na nitu, mu mbandu, kubasisa morphine ya bambuma ya nti ya coquelicot na scopolamine ya me katuka na banti ya nkanka.

src: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
trg: Bo zabaka mbote kuzenga binama ya nitu sambu na kugulusa bambefo na gangrene, mpi kukanga lele na na nitu ya mbefo sambu menga kulanda ve kubasika.

src: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
trg: Naanima ya nkama ya bamvula mingi, kimfumu ya Roma nungaka na diambu ya kimunganga mpi basisaka mayele mingi ya beto me zababubu yayi.

src: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.
trg: Origami Pureland kele origami yina ke tubaka kaka nde kima mosi mpamba lenda salama na mbala mosi, bima ya mpasi bonso bima ya kubaluka, bo ke pesaka yo ve nzila, mpi bima yonso ke andaka ti bisika ya mfunu.

src: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.
trg: John Smith muntu salaka yo na 1970 sambu na kupesa maboko na bantu ya me zaba ve kisalu mpi yina kele ti nzayilu fioti ya moteur.

src: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.
trg: Bana ke kumaka kuzaba mpusu ya nitu mpi luswaswanu ya bampusu ya nitu na kileke mpenza mpi yo ke vandaka ti bupusi na bikalulu na bo.

src: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.
trg: Mu mbandu, bana yina ke monaka nde bo kele na kimvuka ya fioti yina bo ke vwzaka, mbala mingi bo ke vandaka ve mayele na nzo-nkanda kana bo me yantika kuzaba nde bantu ke vwezaka mpusu ya nitu na bo.

src: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.
trg: MySpace kele site internet ya tatu yina bantu ke sadilaka mingi na Etats-Unis mpi yo kele ti bantu kiteso ya bamilio 54.

src: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.
trg: Bantu ke tulaka dikebi mingi na basite internet yai, mingimingi sambu na kulonguka.

src: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.
trg: Kele ti mambu ya mbote sambu na basite internet yai, mu mbandu, kuyidika na pete yonso lutiti ya nzo-nkanda yina lenda vanda ti bablogs, bavideo, bafoto, mpi bima ya nkaka.

src: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.
trg: Bantu lenda kukota kukonda mpasi na lutiti yai kaka kana bo kele ti adresi web mosi; yo ke salaka nde yo vanda pete na kuyibuka mpi pete na kusonika sambu na balongoki yina me zaba mbote ve kusadila clavier to kusonika mbote.

src: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
trg: Bo lenda yidika yo sambu na konso muntu sambu yo vanda pete na kutanga mpi yo vanda ve ti ba couleur mingi.

src: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".
trg: Attention Deficit Desorder "kele kimbefo ya ntu yina syndrome ya neurone yina bidimbu na yo tatu kele kuwa makasi nswalu, kukuka ve kutula dikebi na kima mosi, mpi kusala mingi to kuvanda ti kikesa mingi kuluta".

src: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".
trg: Yo kele ve maladi ya kukonda mayele, yo kele kimbefo ya ke salaka nde muntu vanda ve mayele; "bana 3 tii na 5 na kati ya nkama ke belaka yo, mpi ziku bantu ya Amerika kiteso ya bamilio 2 ke belaka yo."

src: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.
trg: Bana yina kele na ADD ke kukaka ve kutula mabanza kisika mosi na mambu bonso kisalu ya klase, kansi bo ke tulaka mabanza na mambu ya bo ke zolak mu mbandu kusakana to kutala ba dessin animé ya bo ke zolaka to kusonika bansa kukonda kutula kidimbu ya kupema.

src: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.
trg: Mbala mingi, bana yai ke kudisosilaka bampasi mingi, sambu "bo ke kudipesaka na bikalulu ya kigonsa, ke nwanaka, mpi ke telaminaka kiyeka" sambu na kutedimisa butomfu na bo, sambu bo lenda tedimisa ve butomfu na bo na mitindu ya mbote.

src: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.
trg: ADD ke bebisaka kuwakana na bo ti bana ya nkaka sambu bana ya nkaka lenda bakisa ve sambu na nki bo kesalaka mambu mutidnu bo ke salaka yo to sambu na nki bo ke sonikaka mutindu bo ke salaka yo to sambu kuyela na bo me swaswana.

src: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.
trg: Makuki ya kubaka nzayilu mpi ya kulonguka sobaka na mutindu beto tubaka na zulu mpila ya kubaka nzayilu mpi sobaka.

src: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.
trg: Mutindu ya kubaka bansangu vandaka ya kuswaswana. Yo vandaka diaka ve mfunu na kubinga diaka muntu, kansi bo kmaka kutula dikebi mingi na kuyibuka mambu ya bo tubaka.

src: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.
trg: Na kutuba ya kieleka, mouvema ya Renaissance salaka nsoba ya nene na mutindu ya kulonguka mpi ya kupanza mayele.

src: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.
trg: Na kuswaswana ti baprimate ya nkaka, hominidés ke sadilaka diaka ve maboko sambu na kutambula to kunata bizitu to kupumbuka na banti.

src: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.
trg: Maboko na makulu ya makaku kele nda mpi nene mutindu mosi, yo yina bo lenda sadila maboko na kunata kilo ntangu yo ke tambula.

src: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.
trg: Diboko ya muntu kele nkufi kuluta dikulu, yo ke ti misapi ya kutandama.

src: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
trg: Mikwa ya diboko ya fossile yina kele ti bamvula bamilio zole to tatu ke monisa nsoba ya me salamaka na diboko sambu na kunikana mpi kusala kisalu.

src: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.
trg: Bantu ya nkaka ke yindulaka nde kulala bandosi ya polele ya kusosa na banzila ya bisalu ya nkaka mbala mingi kuluta lenda kulembisa ngolo.

src: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.
trg: Kikuma ya ntete ya diambu yai kele nde bandosi ya mbote ke kumisaka nda ntangu yina kele na kati ya bitini ya REM.

src: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.
trg: Kana nge ke sala ba REM foiti na mpimpa mosi, ntangu yina nge ke lalaka mpenza mpi nitu na nge ke baka diaka ve ngolo ebuna yo ke kumaka diambu ya mpasi.

src: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.
trg: Yo ke lembisaka bonso nde nge fwete telama konso mbala na nima ya minitu makumi zole to tatu mpi kutala TV.

src: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.
trg: Bupusi na yo ke tadilaka mbala ikwa butomfu na nge ke mekaka kulala bandosi na mpimpa mosi.

src: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.
trg: Mambu kwendilaka ve mbote sambu na bantu ya Italie na Afrika ya Norde banda na luyantiku. Na nima ya mposo mosi ya Italie tubaka nde bo me yantika bitumba na le 10 juin 1940, Basoda ya b Anglais ya 11 Hussar botulaka mbanza Fort Capuzzo na Lybie.

src: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.
trg: Na kisika ya bo bumbanaka na esti ya Bardia, ba Britanniki kangaka mfumu ya Ba ingénieur ya Kimvuka ya kumi ya basoda ya Italie, général Lastucci.

src: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.
trg: Na le 28 juin, Marshal Italo Balbo, Ntwadisi ya nene ya Lybie mpi muntu zolaka kuyinga Mussolini, bo fwaka yandi na masasi ya banduku na bo na bwala Tobruk.

src: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.
trg: Bansaka ya bubu ya kunwana na bambele, bo ke salaka yo na bisika mingi, banda na balongoki ya iniversite tii na bantu ya me zaba yo mpi na bansaka ya Olympique.

src: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.
trg: Bo ke nwanaka yo na bantu zole, muntu mosi ke nwana ti muntu ya nkaka.

src: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.
trg: Golf kele nsaka yina ba joueur ke sadilaka banti sambu na kubula baalon yo kota na mabulu.

src: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.
trg: Bo ke sadilaka mabulu kumi na nana mbala mingi, ebuna yo ke lombaka ba joueur kuyantika na dibulu ya ntete mpi kumanisa na dibulu ya kumi na nana.

src: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.
trg: Joueur yina ke bulaka batire fioti, to kunikisa nti mbala mingi ve, sambu na kumanisa mabulu yonso muntu ke nungaka.

src: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.
trg: Bo ke bulaka nsaka yai na zulu ya matiti, mpi matiti ya ke vandaka na nziunga ya dibulu ke vandaka nkufi mpi bo ke bingaka yo green.

src: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.
trg: Mbala ya nkaka mutindu ya me zabana mingi ya tourisme kele yina bantu mingi ke wakanisaka ti kusala nzietelo: Tourisme ya kusakana.

src: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.
trg: Yo kele ntangu bantu ke kwendaka na kisika yina me swaswana kibeni ti luzingu na bo ya konso kiluombu sambu na kupema mpi kusepela.

src: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.
trg: Mbala mingi mabungu, baparke mpi ba camp kele bisika yina bo ke kwendaka mbala mingi na tourisme ya kusakana.

src: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.
trg: Kana kikuma ya kutala kisika mosi mpidiayi kele ya kuzaba disolo mpi kinkulu na yo, mpidina bo ke bingaka yo ttourisme culturel.

src: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.
trg: Batouriste lenda kwenda kutala bisika ya kuswaswana na bwala mosi to bo lenda baka lukanu ya kukwenda kutala kaka kisika mosi.

src: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.
trg: Sambu bo monaka mambu yai, bantu yina vandaka kuyala na ngolo lombaka lusadisu ya basoda ya nkaka.

src: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).
trg: Basoda kwisaka kusadisa bayina vandaka na ntwala, yo vandaka kimvuka ya 1 mpi ya 3 ya New Hampshire yina vandaka ti bantu 200; bantu twadisaka bo kele ba colonl John Stark mpi James Redd (bo zole kumaka bageneral na nima).

src: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.
trg: Baasoda ya Stark bakaka kisika na ndilu ya norde ya kisika bantu ya vandaka kuyala na ngolo vandaka.

src: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.
trg: Ntangu masa kungulaka nzila na Nzadi Mystic na norde-este ya ksanga, bo kumisaka ndilu yina nda ti kibaka ya ditadi na norde mpi ndilu sukaka nsuka ya masa na ka dibungu.

src: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.
trg: Gridley to Stark tulaka kibaka ya makulu kiteso ya 100 (30 m) na ntwala ya ndilu mpi pesaka ntma nde ata muntu mosi ve kubula masai tii kuna basoda ta luta.

src: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.
trg: Bantu ya Amerika vandaka ti ngindu ya kunwanisa bantu na bandambu tatu ya kuswaswana.

src: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.
trg: Gnerla Jaoh G=Cadwalder nwanisaka basoda ya Grande Bretagne na Bordentown, sambu na kukanga bo nzila ya kubaka ve binwaninu ya nkaka.

src: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.
trg: Général James Ewing nataka basoda 700 na simu ya nkaka ya masa na Trenton Ferry, yandi botulaka pont ya Assunpink Creek mpi kukanga basoda ya bambeni nzila ya kutina.

src: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.
trg: Basoda ya mingi 2 400 sabukaka nzadi na kitamina ya bamiles uvwa na norde ya Trenton, mpi na nima bo kabwanaka na bimvuka zole, mosi na nsi ya lutwadisu ya Greene mpi ya nkaka na nsi ya lutwadisu ya Sullivan, sambu na kuyantika bitumba.

src: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.
trg: Na kukatuka na ndambu na iya (quart) mpi kukwenda na katikati ya kilometere, ntinu ke vandaka mfunu mingi ve kansi kukanda-ntina nde ke kumaka mfunu kuluta.

src: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.
trg: Ya kieleka, muntu ya classe ya ntete ya katikati, muntu yina lenda kununga na ba minuta zole, fwete vanad ntinu mingi, kansi yandi fwete yedisa kibeni kukanga ntima.

src: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.
trg: Bantinu ya nkaka ya nsungi ya madidi, kumosi ti ngalasisi ya kitini ya zulu ya nitu, kele mutindu ya mbote kibeni ya kudibongisa sambu na nsungi ya kubaka ntinu.

src: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.
trg: Kudia madia ya mbote yo mosi mpamba lenda ve kusadisa muntu na kununga, kansi yo lenda sadisaka mingi na sante ya mvibma ya muntu ya ke salaka bansaka.

src: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.
trg: Kuvanda ti mavimpi ya mbote, kuvanda ti kikalulu ya mbote ya kunwa masa, mpi kubakisa bitini ya mutindu na mutindu ya bangalasisi lenda sadisa muntu ya ke salaka bansaka na kutomisa mayele na yandi mpi na kuvanda na kiese mingi na nsaka yina.

src: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.
trg: Nsaka ya kubaka ntinu ya katikati ke lombaka mbongo mingi ve; kansi kele ti bangindu mingi ya luvunu ya ke tdila bisadilu yina kele mfunu sambu nge sala nsaka yango.

src: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.
trg: Nge lenda sumba bima yina kana nge kele na mfunu na yo, kansi mingi ta vanda ti bupusi fioti to ata fioti ve na ngolo na nge.

src: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.
trg: Bantu ya ke bakaka ntinu lenda yindula nde bo ke zola kima mosi ata ntangu yo ke natilaka bo ve ata mambote mosi.

src: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.
trg: Bantu ke tubaka nde atome kele na kati ya bima ya mfunu ya bima yonso.

src: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.
trg: Yo kele mpila mosi ya nene yayi kele, na modele ya Bohr, na noyau central ya orbite nzinga nzinga ya baelectron, mpila mosi na baplanete yina ke vandaka na nziunga ya ntangu, tala Kifwanisu 1.1.

src: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.
