trg: Munkanzi ke vandaka na bitini zole - neutrons mpi protons.

src: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.
trg: Ba protons kele na courant ya mbote kansi neutrons kele ve na courant. Ba electrons kele na courant ya mbi.

src: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.
trg: Sambu na kutala victime, nge fwete tala ntete kisika yina mambu salamaka sambu na kuzaba kana nge kele na lutaninu.

src: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.
trg: Nge fwete zaba position ya muntu ya bo me sala mbi ntangu nge ke finama na yandi mpi konso kidimbu ya ya bo me tula.

src: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.
trg: Kana nge me lwala ntangu nge ke meka kusadisa, nge lenda sadisa kaka na kukumisa mambu mbi kuluta.

src: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.
trg: Bansosa me monisa nde kuniokwama na mabanza, boma, mpi bampasi ke sobaka kuwakana ya kele na kati ya mpasi mpi bampasi ya kele na nsi ya mukongo.

src: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.
trg: Bo ke tadilaka mbala na mbala na malongi ya PA ya konso mposo kaka bupusi ya mpasi, kansi ve ya kuniokwama na mabanza mpi ya boma.

src: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.
trg: Bayina ke salaka bisalu mbala na mbala ke vandaka na mfunu ya lusadisu mingi na yina me tala bangindu ya mbi sambu na mpasi, luswaswanu na kati ya mpasi ya ke manaka ve mpi kudiwa ve mbote kana nge me sala kima ya nge ke salaka mbala na mbala.

src: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.
trg: Mbona-meso, to mayele ya kumona, ke tadilaka bisalu ya kumona, binama ya kuwila to meso.

src: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.
trg: Kele ti mitindu mingi ya kuswaswana ya kutunga meso, na mpasi na yo na kutadila mambu yina nitu ya muntu ke lomba.

src: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.
trg: Mitindu ya kuswaswana ya kutunga kele ti makuki ya kuswaswana, ke tulaka dikebi mingi na nda ya makelele, mpi na badegre ya kubakisa, diaka, yo ke lombaka mayele ya kuswaswana sambu na kubakisa mambu mpi sambu bantalu ya kuswaswana kusala mbote.

src: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.
trg: Population kele kimvuka ya bantu/bima ya mutindu mosi buna ya kele na kisika mosi buna.

src: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.
trg: Ntangu bantu yonso ya kisika mosi kele mutindu mosi na yina me tala diambu mosi ya phénotypique, bo ke tubaka nde bo kele monomorphique.

src: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.
trg: Kana bantu kele ti ke monisa bikalulu ya kuswaswana ya kima mosi, bo ke tubaka nde bokele polymorphique.

src: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.
trg: Kimvuka ya bafurmi ke tambulaka mpi ke butaka na bitambi ya kuswaswana.

src: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.
trg: Na kitambi ya kukwenda kisika ya nkaka, kimvuka ya bafurmi ke tambulaka na mpimpa mpi ke telamaka na ntangu sambu na kupema.

src: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.
trg: Kimvuka ke yantikaka kutambula kana madia na bo kele diaka ve mingi. Na nsungi yai, kimvuka ke salaka banzala ya ntangu fioti yina yo ke sobaka konso kilumbu.

src: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.
trg: Konso kitini ya kutambula yai ke bakaka bilumbu kiteso ya 17.

src: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.
trg: Selile kele inki? Ngogo yina me katuka na ngogo ya Latin "cella", yina ke tendula "chambre ya fyoti," mpi muntu mosi ya microscopie muntu pesaka yo zina yina na mbala ya ntete ntangu yandi vandaka kutala nitu ya musopi.

src: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.
trg: Selile kele kitini ya mfunu ya bima yonso ya kele na luzingu, mpi bima yonso ke vandaka ti selile mosi to baselile mingi.

src: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".
trg: Baselile kele mpi mfunu mingi sambu na kulonguka luzingu, yo yina bo ke bingaka yo mbala mingi nde "'briki ya kutunga luzingu'".

src: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.
trg: Système nerveux ke taninaka homéostasie na muitndu yo ke tindaka ngolo na banerf na nzila ya nitu sambu menga landa kutambula kukonda mavwanga.

src: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.
trg: Yo lenda tinda kuningana ya banerfs to misisa nswalu na nti ya mvimba ebuna yo ke taninaka nitu na bigonsa yonso ya ke nwanisa yo.

src: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.
trg: Mipepe ya ngolo ke bulaka na bisika ya fiotii kana beto fwanisa yo ti mipepoe ya nkaka ya ngolo mingi, kansi yo lenda bebisa bima onso na nzila na yo.

src: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
trg: Mipepe ya ngolo lenda tumuna banti, kubwisa ba yinzo mpi kunangula bakamio na zulu. 2 % ya mipepe ya ngolo kuluta ke salaka ve bangunga kuluta tatu.

src: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
trg: Mipepe yai ya mbi ke vandaka ti vitesi tii na 480 km / h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

src: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.
trg: Bantu ke salaka mpi ke sadilaka maneti sambu na kudikumisa kitoko bantu bamvula mingi kibeni.

src: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.
trg: Kansi, batelescope ya ntete ya kieleka, bo salaka yo na Europa na mvu-nkama ya 16.

src: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.
trg: Batelescope yai ke sadilaka maneti zole sambu na kusala nde bima ya kele ntama kumona bonso nde yo kele pene-pene mpi nene kibeni.

src: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly
trg: Bwimi mpi lukasi ta vandaka ntangu yonso ti beto mpi yo kikalulu ya kusala kumosi ke monisaka nde ntangu bantu mingi ke baka mambote, yo ta vandaka ntangu yonso ti mambote mingi ya kubaka na ntangu fioti kana nge kele ti bwimi.

src: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.
trg: Yo kele kiese sambu, bantu mingi ta bakisa nde sambu na mambote na bo ya ntangu mingi, bo fwete sala kumosi ti bankaka.

src: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.
trg: Bantu mingi ke vingilaka kilumbu yina bantu lenda tambula na mbwetete ya nkaka mpi kukwenda kutala bansi ya nkaka, bantu ya nkaka ke kudiyulaka nki ke vandaka kuna mpi bankaka ke yindula nde banzenzato luzingu ya ya nkaka lenda vanda na planete ya nkaka.

src: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".
trg: Kansi, kana yo salama, mbala ya nkaka yo ta salama ntama kibeni na bilumbu ke kwisa. Bambwetete me panzanaka kuna na zulu yo yina yo kele ti bamiliare ya kitamina na kati ya bambwetete yina kele "mfinama".

src: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?
trg: Ziku kilumbu kele, bantekolo na nge ta telama ya kusungama na nsi ya kuyituka, mpi ke kudiyula banani vandaka ba-nkaka na bo ya ntama?

src: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.
trg: Bambisi ke vandaka ti baselila mingi. Bo ke diaka bima mpi ke bumbaka yo na kati. Bambisi mingi lenda tambula.

src: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).
trg: Bambisi mpamba ke vandaka ti babutomfu (ata yo kele ve bambisi yonso; mu mbandu, meduse ke vandaka ve ti babutomfu).

src: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.
trg: Bambisi ke vandaka bisika yonso na ntoto. Yo ke timunaka ntoto, ke kasaka na banzadi-mungwa, mpi ke pumbukaka na zulu.

src: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.
trg: Selile kele kima ya kuluta fioti mpi ya mfunu mingi na bima ya kele na luzingu.

src: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.
trg: Selila me katuka na ngogo ya Latin cella yina ke tendula chambre ya fioti.

src: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.
trg: Kana nge tala bima ya ke zingaka na microscope, nge ta mona nde bo me salama na ba carre to serkele ya fioti.

src: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.
trg: Robert Hooke, biologiste ya Angleterre, monaka na kati ya microscope ba carrés ya fioti na Liège.

src: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
trg: Yo vandaka bonso bachambre. Yandi vandaka muntu ya ntete ya kumona baselila ya kufwa.

src: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
trg: Bima mpi bitini lenda katuka na mutindu mosi mpi kukuma mutindu ya nkaka, kansi yo soba ve.

src: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
trg: Azote kana yo kele mupepe ke vandaka ti bikalulu ya mutindu mosi ti azote ya masa. Kana yo kele masa yo ke andaka ngolo kansi ke vandaka ti bamolecule ya kiteso mosi.

src: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
trg: Masa kele mbandu ya nkaka. Masa me salama na bima baatome zole ya hydrogene mpi atome mosi ya oxygene.

src: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
trg: Yo kele na ba molecule ya mutindu mosi yo vanda ntangu yo kele mupepe, masa, to ngolo.

src: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
trg: Ata yo lenda soba mpila yo kele, bima na yo ke vandaka mutindu mosi.

src: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.
trg: Ntangu kele kima mosi ya kele mfinama na beto, mpi yo ke simbaka makambu yonso beto ke salaka, kansi yo ke vandaka mpasi sambu na kubakisa yo.

src: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.
trg: Bantu ya lusambu, ya filozofi, mpi ya siansi ke longukaka ntangu to ngunga banda ntama kibeni.

src: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.
trg: Beto ke bakaka ntangu bonso bitini ya mambu ya ke salama katuka na bilumbu ke kwisa, nge luta na bilumbu na beto mpi na bilumbu ya me lutaka.

src: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
trg: Ntangu kele mpi mutindu beto ke tesaka nda ya mambu ya ke salama.

src: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
trg: Nge lenda tula kidimbu nge mosi na mutindu ntangu ke luta kana nge ke tala mutindu mambu ke landa na kusalama. Mambu ya ke landa na kusalama ke salamaka mbala na mbala.

src: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.
trg: Bubu yai bo ke sadilaka ba ordinatele sambu na kuyidika bafoto mpi bavideo.

src: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.
trg: Bo lenda sala ba animation ya kuyituka na ba ordinateur, ebuna mutindu ya animation yai bantu me kumaka kusadila yo mingi na television mpi na cinéma.

src: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.
trg: Mbala mingi bo ke kotisaka ndinga ya miziki na mayele ya kuyituka ya ordinateur mpi bo ke vukisaka ndinga kisika mosi.

src: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
trg: Na ntangu mingi na nsungi ya mvu-nkama ya 19 mpi ya 20, bantu vandaka kuyindula bantu ya ntete yina zingaka na Nouvelle-Zelande kvandaka ba Maori, yina andaka kuzomba bandeke ya nene ya bo ke bingaka moas.

src: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
trg: Bo kumaka kutuba nde bantu ya Maori katukaka na Polynesie na Maswa ya Nene mpi kwisaka na Nouvelle Zelande katuka na Moriori, ebuna bo salaka kimvuka ya bantu ya ke salaka kisalu ya bilanga.

src: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
trg: Kansi, banzikisa ya mpa ke monisa nde Moriori vandaka kimvuka ya bantu ya Maori yina kwisaka na Nouvelle Zelande katuka na Bisanga ya Chatham, bo yeisaka kinkulu ya ngemba mpi ya bo mosi.

src: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
trg: Kuvandaka mpi ti dikanda ya nkaka na bisanga ya Chatham, bo vandaka ba Maori yina katukaka ntama na Nouvelle Zelande.

src: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
trg: Bo vandaka kudibinga ba Moriori, bo vandaka mwa fioti mpi na nsuka, bo fwaka ba Moriori yonso.

src: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.
trg: Bantu yina me kudipesaka bantu ntama sadisaka beto na kusepela ti ngolo na beto mpi bima ya beto ke zolaka ntangu ke bakisa bampasi na beto mpi kukonda kununga na beto.

src: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.
trg: Ntangu beto ke widikila bantu ke ta masolo na bo mosi, ya mabuta na bo, mpi ya bimvuka na bo, beto ke bakisaka mambu ya bo kutanaka ti yo na ntangu ya ntama mpi bikalulu ya nkaka yina vandaka ti bupusi ya mbote to ya mbi na kimvuka na bo.

src: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.
trg: Ata kuzaba disolo ya muntu ke tendula ve kubakisa kinkulu na yandi, kansi yo ke sadisaka mwa fioti na kuzaba kisika na bo na kati ya disolo ya kimvuka na bo.

src: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.
trg: Ntangu beto ke tadila kununga mpi ke bakisa bisika beto nungakave, muntu mosi-msoi mpi kimvuka ya bantu ke vukanaka na kuzaba mbote bikalulu, kisalu, mpi bikuma ya ke pusaka kimvuka na kusala mambu.

src: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.
trg: Na mbandu yai, kuyibuka bikalulu ya ntama ya kisalu yina basisaka kununga mpi sadisaka bantu na kundima bansoba ya mpa mpi lutwadisu ya mpa na nzo-nzambi na bo.

src: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.
trg: Masolo ya mutindu yai ya kununga kulumusaka boma ya nsoba, mpi kusala bangindu ya mbote sambu na nsoba ya ta salama na bilumbu ke kwisa.

src: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.
trg: Mutindu ya kuyindula kele mayele ya kuyidika mambu sambu na kuvukisa bangindu to mambu ya me swaswana sambu na kuyidika diambu mosi.

src: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.
trg: Mutindu yai ya kuyindula ke tula dikebi ntete na ntinu, logique mpi busikisiki, mpi kuzaba mambu ya kieleka, kusadila mayele yina bo kele deja ti yo mpi kuvukisa bansangu.

src: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.
trg: Kima ya mfunu mingi na mutindu yai ya kuyindula kele yai: mvutu ya mbote ke vandaka kaka mosi. Nge fwana kuyindula kaka na bamvutu zole, ya mbote to ya mbi.

src: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.
trg: Bo ke sadilaka mutindu yayi ya kuyindula na basiansi to mitindu ya nkaka ya kusala mambu.

src: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.
trg: Bantu ya ke yindulaka mutindu yai, ke yindulaka na mutindu ya mbote, ke kangaka mutindu ya kusala mambu, ke yidikaka mambu mpi ke salaka bateste ya siansi.

src: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.
trg: Bantu kele bigangwa ya mayele mingi na yina me tala kutanga na bangindu ya bantu ya nkaka.

src: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.
trg: Yo ke tendula nde lenda kuka kuzaba mbote mambu yian bantu ya nkaka ke yindula, ke kana, ke kwikila, ke zaba to ke zola.

src: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.
trg: Na kati ya mayele yango, kubakisa mambu ya muntu ke kana kusala kele mfunu mingi. Yo ke sadisaka na kumanisa makambu ya mpasi ya bisalu ya nitu.

src: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.
trg: Mu mbandu, kana nge ke mona muntu mosi ke pasula kitalatala ya kamio, nge lenda tuba nde yandi ke zola kuyiba kamio ya muntu ya nkaka.

src: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
trg: Beto fwete tadila yandi mutindu ya nkaka kana yandi vidisaka bansapi ya kamio na yandi mpi kamio yina yandi ke sosa kukota na kati kele kamio na yandi mosi.

src: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).
trg: MRI me simbama na mambu ya physique na zina ya Résonance Magnétique Nucléaire (NMR), yina Felix Bloch (vandaka kusala na iniversite ya Stanford) na Edward Purcell (ya iniversite ya Harvard) monaka yo na bamvu 1930.

src: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.
trg: Na résonance yayi, champ magnetique mpi onde ya radio ke pusaka ba atomes na kupesa basignales ya fioti ya radio.

src: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.
trg: Na mvu 1970, Raymond Damadian, munganga mpi muntu ya ke salaka bansosa ya siansi, bakisaka kikuma ya kusadila bifwanisu ya résonance magnétique bonso kisadilu sambu na kuzaba maladi ya muntu ke bela.

src: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.
trg: Mvula iya na nima, bo pesaka diplome mosi, yo vandaka diplome ya ntete ya bo pesaka muntu na mambu ya IRM.

src: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.
trg: Na 1977, Dr Damadian manisaka kusala scanner ya ntete IRM "ya nitu ya mvimba", yandi pesaka yo zina "ya bo lenda nunga ve".

src: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.
trg: Kusolola ya Asynchrone ke siamisaka na kubaka ntangu ya kuyindula mpi ya kuwa bangindu ya bantu ya nkaka.

src: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.
trg: Yo ke pesaka balongoki nzila ya kusala na vitesi na bo mosi mpi na kuyala bo mosi vitesi yina bo ke longuka mambu.

src: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)
trg: Diaka, bandilu ya ntangu kele mingi ve sambu nge lenda soba yo mutindu nge me zola. (Bremer, 1998)

src: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.
trg: Kusadila Internet ti Site Internet ya Ntoto ya Mvimba ke sadisaka balongoki na kubaka bansangu konso ntangu.

src: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
trg: Balongoki lenda tinda mpi bangiufula na balongi na bo na konso ntangu na kilumbu mpi kuvingila bamvutu mwa nswalu, na kisika ya kuvingila ndenge bo kutana kisika mosi.

src: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.
trg: Mayele ya bilumbu ke kwisa ke pesa kibeni kimpwanza na mambu yonso. Mitindu ya mbote ya kulonguka kele mingi.

src: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.
trg: Ya kieleka, mambu ya mbote ya kulonguka kele mingi. Kulonguka ke salamaka na kuwakana na kati ya longoki mpi nzayilu yina bo ke longa yandi.

src: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.
trg: Mayele na beto ya sesepi ya ke tuba nde sala yo nge mosi mpi bansangu ya bo ke pesa beto, mpi malongi ya me simbamana manaka ya television ke monisa diambu yai.

src: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.
trg: Bantu mingi kibeni na kati na beto ke talaka manaka ya télévision yina ke songaka beto bametode to mambu yina beto ta salaka ve to yina beto ta sadilaka ve mayele na yo.

src: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
trg: Beto ta takangulaka ve kamio sambu na kuyidika yo, beto ta salaka ve fontaine ya masa na kibansala, ta salaka ve nzietelo na Pérou sambu na kutala bisika ya ntama, mpi beto ta yidikaka ve nzo ya voisin na beto.

src: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.
trg: Matondo sambu na nsinga ya fibre ya opitiki yina Bo me lutisa na insi ya imbu ke vukana na Europe na satelite, bana ya Groenland me kuma na nzila ya kusadila internet na kiteso ya 93%.

src: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.
trg: Inzo nange ya mvundulu to biyambi nzenza (kana nge vanda na inzo ya banzenza to na nzo ya mvundulu ya bamvwama) ke fwama vanda na wifi to ordinatele ina ke na interneti na bifulu yonso ke na inzo ya internet cafe to bifuku ya nkaka ya bantu yonso kisika wifi kele.

src: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.
trg: Mutindu yo me talana, ngogo "Eskimo" me kundimama na insi ya America, yo kele ngogo yina bantu mingi ke zingaka ve na Artic ke kuzolaka yo ve, mutindu na Canada.

src: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.
trg: Ata nge lenda wa bankwa-bwala ya Groenland ke sadila ngogo yina bo mosi, banzenza fwete sadila yo ve.

src: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.
trg: Bantu ina butukaka na Groenland ke kubingaka bo mosi ba Inuit na Canada mpi Kaaalleq (kana mingi Kalaalliti), Greenlander, na Greenland.

src: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."
trg: Mambi, ti ntima mbi na kusadisa banzenza kele kima Groenland ke salaka ve. Ata na bambanza nene "bisika ya mpasi" yo kele ve.

src: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.
trg: Nsungi ya madidi lenda vanda kigonsa mosi kaka ya ngolo bantu ina kuyilamaka ve ta kutana na yo.

src: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.
trg: Kana beno me kwenda kutala Groenland na ntangu ya madidi (zaba nde na ntangu beno kekwenda mingi mingi na nord, madidi mpi kele ngolo), yo kele mfunu na kuvwata bilele ke lunda tiya.

src: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.
trg: Bilumbu ya inda ya mwiniyo lenda kubasisa makambu na kubaka ntangu kulunga ya mpongi ti mpasi na nitu.

src: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.
trg: Na ntangu ya mwini ya ngolo, beno sala keba na bambembele ya norde. Ata bo pesaka kubela ve, bo lenda kufwemisa nitu ngoloi.

src: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.
trg: Na ntangu nzangululu ya San Francisco ke ya kuvikana na mutindu yo kele kisika ya kitoko ya nsi-ntoto ke bendaka bibumini bisika ya nzenza, nzangululu na yo kele ya mutindu mingi.

src: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.
trg: Bisika ya kisalu me luta nene ya mfunu kele bisalu ya nene,luyalu, bambongo, kuteka na kusumba ti tourisme.

src: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.
trg: Ntinula ya yandi ya ntangu a mbidi na ngimbudulu, sindima, nsonokono mpi kintama ya kuzabakana sadisaka na Kutunga ya mbanza mpi bifulu ya mbote kwisa kuzabakana na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba.

src: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.
trg: San Francisco kumatisaka kisalu mosi ya nene ya bantu ya ke salaka nzietelo na nzila ya hôtel ya mingi, ba restaurant ti banzo ya congrès ya ndonga ya ntete.

src: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.
trg: San Francisco kele diaka mosi ya bisika ya mbote mingi ya bwala sambu na madia ya nkaka ya Azia: Korea,Thaï, Inde mpi Japon.

src: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.
trg: Kusala nzietelo na Walt Disney World yo kele nzietelo ya nene sambu na mabuta ya mingi ya bantu ya Amerika.

src: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.
trg: Viziti ya "kingenga" ke lombaka kukwenda na avion na aeroport ya bansi mingi ya Orlando, kukwenda na bisi na hotel Disney, kulutisa kiteso ya mposo mosi kukonda kubikisa Disney, mpi kuvutuka kisika nge katukaka.

src: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".
trg: Bansoba kele mingi kibeni, kansi yai kima ya bantu mingi ke tubilaka ntangu bo ke tubilaka "Kukwenda na Mbanza ya Disney".

src: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.
trg: Batiket mingi ya bo tekaka na nzila ya interneti na nzila ya sites interneti bonso eBay to Craigslist bo ke sadilaka batike ya kusadila mbala mingi.

src: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.
trg: Ata yo ke salamaka na kisalu, yo ke pekisamaka na Disney: babiye yo kele ya kupesama na muntu nkaka ve.

src: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.
trg: Nganda yonso na nsi ya lweke ya Grand Canyon ke lomba nswa ya bamfumu ya bwala ntama kuna.

src: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
trg: Mikanda ya nswa ke fioti sambu na kutanina mvwila nene, mpi yoke kumonanaka na kilumbu ya ntete ya ngonda, ngonda iya na ntwala ya ngonda kuyantika.

src: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.
trg: Yo yina, nswa ya bwala ya ntama na badati ke yantika na dati ya ke vanda na mai ke monanaka na dati ya janvier 1.

src: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.
trg: Bisika ya bifula yina me zabanai mingi, mutindu mpaka ya Bright Angel ke sika mosi na Mpaka ya Phantom, mingi fulukaka na bandombolo kubumbisa kisika na kilumbu ya ntete.

src: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.
trg: Ntalu ya bamaswa ke pesa nzila na kutambula kele fioti, nge fwana vanda ya ntete sambu nge kuzwa yo.

src: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.
trg: Kukota na Afrika ya sudi na kamio ke nzila ya mbote ya kutadila kitoko ya bwala mpi ku kuma na bifulu yina ke na nzila ya bazieti ve.

src: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.
trg: Yai lenda salama na vetile ya mbote kana yo me yilama mbote mbote, kansi 4x4 kele mfunu kuluta mpi sambu kukuma na bisika mingi 4x4 ke na mfunu sambu na pinei ya zulu.

src: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.
trg: Beno tula na yitu yina beno ke zonza Afrika ya sude kele na ngemba, yo kele ve mutindu mosi na ba ba insi yina ya bampangi me kuzungidila yandi.

src: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.
trg: Yina ya me lombama sambu na visa mpi ntalu na yo ke kuswaswana nsi na insi mpi ke tala mingi wapi insi nge me katuka.

src: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.
trg: Konso bwala kele na nsiku ya kutuba nde voiture yonso fwete vanda na bartkele na kati.

src: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.
trg: Victoria Falls kele bwala kimfumu ya kitini ya Weste ya Zimbabwe, na ngambu ya nkaka ya Livingstone, na Zambie, ti pene-pene ya Botswana.

src: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.
trg: Bwala ke na kisika na yo na nima ya bifulu ya mabulu, mpi yo kele bima ya ke bendaka bantu mingi, kansi kisika yayi ya bantu ke zolaka kukwenda kutala ke vandaka ya mbote sambu na bantu ya ke sosaka kiese mpi mabaku ya kulutisa ntangu mingi.

src: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.
trg: Na nsungi ya mvula (ngonda yaNovemba ti ya Malasi), ndilu ya masa ata mata na zulu mpi Falls ke vandaka makelele ngolo mingi.

src: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
trg: Ya me kutezwa kana nge me sabuka kimvu nge ke bola to kana nge tambula na nzili ya fioti ke nataka pene-pene masa ke buaka ngolo.

src: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
trg: Na kisika ya nkaka, sambu na kiteso ya masa kele mingi ntalulu ya nge ya Falls na ngolo ke vanda mbote ve--yo kekangama na asa yonso.

src: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.
trg: Maziamu ya Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 lenda vanda yina me zabakana mingi kati na maziamu ke na ntwala masa to Vallée, kidimbu ya kusonga yina Howard Carter talaka na 1922 na kisika ya maziamu ya Kimfumu ya ntotila yina ya leke.

src: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.
trg: Kansi na kufwanisa na maziamu ya nkaka ya kimfumu, ndiamu ina ya Toutankhamon ke kaka mfunu fioti bantu kwenda kutala yo, sambu yo kele fioti mpi bima ya mbote-mbote kele kaka fioti.

src: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.
trg: Konso muntu ke zola kutala imbi yina Bo me sala na mvumbi na ntangu ina bantu zola kubasisa yo na kibumbi yani ke tala nima mpasi sambu ti kaka ntu na mapeka ke monana.

src: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.
trg: Bamvwama yina ba zikaka na maziamu ke vandaka diaka ve na kati, sambu ti ba katulaka bo na Bo nataka bo na Musée ya Ngipiti na Caire.

src: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
trg: Banzenza yina kele na ntangu kaka ya fioti ke sala mbote na kulutisa ntangu ya bo kisika ya kaka.

src: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.
trg: Phnom Krom, 12 kilometre na sude ya Siem Reap. Nsongi ya ngumba ya inzo ya nzambi yayi tungamaka na nsuka ya basenturi 9, na ntangu ya kuzinga ya Ntinu Yasovarman.

src: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.
trg: Ntangu ya imbi ya tempelo na mbweno ya Tonle Sap Lake ke pesa ntalulu ya mbote na ngumba.

src: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.
trg: Kukwenda tala kisika yina lenda kusalama nzila mosi na nzietelo na maswa na kukuma na dizanga nene.

src: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.
trg: Tekila nge kota na tempelo nge fwana vanda na Passeport ya Angkor, na yina kuzimbana ve kunata passeport ya nge yina ke kwisa na Tonle Sap.

src: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.
trg: Yelusaleme kele mbanza kimfumu mpi mbanza ya nene ya Israel, ata mingi kuluta ya bansi mpi Nations Unies ke ndima ve Yelusaleme bonso bwala ya kimfumu ya Israel.

src: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.
trg: Mbanza ya ntama na Judean Hills kele na kintama ya mbote me katuka na mafunda ya bainvu.

src: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.
trg: Mbanza kele ya santu sambu na mabundu tatu ya ke zabaka Nzambi kele mosi - ya bayuda, ya baklistu ti ya islami, mpi ke sala bonso kisika ya nene ya kusambila, inzo ya nzambi ti ya culture.

src: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.
trg: Sambu na mambu ya mabundu ya nzambi ya mbanza, mpi mingi mingi bisika mingi ya kitini ya Mbanza ya ntama, Yelusaleme kele kisika ya ntete wapi bazieti ke kwendaka.

src: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
trg: Yeruzalemi kele na bifulu mingi ke songaka kintama, busosi bima ya ntama ya yisi ya toto na kinkoko, kubwela bamagaze ya nene mpi ya kufuluka na bantu, banzo ya cafe mpi bifulu bantu ke dyaka.

src: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.
trg: Equateur ke lomba nde mwana yonso ya insi ya Cuba kuzwa mukanda ya bo ke bingila yandi na ntwala ya kukota na Equateur na nzila ya aeroport to bisika ya kukota na ndilu ya insi.

src: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.
trg: Mukanda yai fwete kutulwa kiniemo na Ministele ke talaka mambu ya banzenza ya Equateur na kuzitisa ba ndombolo ya luyalu ya bwala.

src: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.
trg: Mambu ya bo ke lombaka, bo me yidikaka yo na bantu ya bansi zole yina kutambula na ndonga.

src: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.
trg: Bana ya insi ya Cuba bo kele na carte verte ya Amerika fwete kwenda na consulat ya Equateur sambu na kuzwa nswa ya kubasika na yina bo me lomba bo.

src: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.
trg: Passeport ya nge fwana kuvanda na mbote bangonda sambanu tekila dati ya nge ya nzietelo. Na ntoto to na avio nge fwana vanda na tike ya nge na kusonga ba ntangu yikwa nge zola zika na bwala to insi.

src: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.
trg: Banzietelo kele na ntalu ya kukuluka na yina me tadila bikunku mingi, na yina kana nge kele nge mosi to na nduku mosi kaka, meka ku bumina bantu ya nkaka na beno ku yidika kikunku ya bantu iya ti sambanu sambu ntalu vanda ya ku kuluka na konso muntu.

src: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.
trg: Diambu yayi lenda kutala beno ve, sambu ti mingi ya Bibumini bisika ke lutisaka ntangu mingi tekila bo zwa bakamio.

src: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.
trg: Yo monanaka bonso kele kima ya mbote ya kukusa bantu kusonga bo nde bofwete futa mingi.

src: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
trg: Kuluta kutombuka na zulu kuna na nsuka ya norde ya Machu Picchu, kele ngumba ya ndelo, mingi-mingi yo ke vandaka bisika ya bafoto ya mbanza ya kufwa.

src: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.
trg: Yo ke pesa kikesa ve na kutala mambu ya ke na insi, yo kele mpasi mpi na kumata, kansi bantu ya ke lunga mbote na mayele fwete lunga kumanisa yo na miniti 45.

src: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.
trg: Bisika ya kutambula na zulu ya matadi yo tulamaka na kitini mosi ya nene ya nzila mpi na bisika ya kukita, bakable ya mabende yo ke pesaka maboko ya lusadisu.

src: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.
trg: Disongidila, yindula kuvanda na mupepe na kivumunu ve na bumba nitu yange ka kukuma ntama ve, sungula na kati ya masa, kuna ya ke kuma imbi mingi.

src: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
trg: Kele ti dibulu ya fioti na zulu yina nge fwete lutila; yo kele kibeni na nsi mpi ya kukangama ngolo.

src: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.
trg: Kumona kisika mpi banmbisi ya Galapagos me salama mbote na bwatu, kaka mpila yina Charles Darwin salaka na 1835.

src: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
trg: Kuluta bamaswa 60 vandada sabuka masa ya Galapagos na mulonga na bantu ya ke sala nzietelo 8 tii na 100.

src: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
trg: Bantu mingi ke kubikaka kisika na bo ya kuvandila mbote mbote (sambu bantu mingi ke vandaka na nzietelo ya maswa na nsungi ya inda).

src: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
trg: Beno zaba mbote agent nge ke sumbila tiki kele muntu me zaba mbote-mbote Galapagos yandi fete kuzaba maswa ya mpila na mpila.

src: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
trg: Yo tasala nde difuti na nge ti / to kupesa mpasi na yayi ke lunga mbote na bwatu ya mbote sambu na bo.

src: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.
trg: Na ntwala bantu ya Espagne kumaka na Senturi 16, Chilie ya norde vandaka na luyalu ya Inca na bantu ya mfinda ya Araucaniens (Mapuche) vandaka zinga na kati-kati ya Chilie na sude.

src: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.
trg: Bamapuche kuvandaka mpi mosi ya bimvuka ya nsuka bankwa ntoto ya Amedika ya kimpwanza, bayayi kuvandaka na domination ya hispanophone kaka na nima ya kimpwanza ya Chili.

src: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.
trg: Ata insi ya Chilie zwaka kimpwanza na 1810 (na nima ya bamvita ya Napoleon nwanaka yina katulaka luyalu ya Espagne ya kati-kati bamvula zole), nungunu na ntwala ya Espagne manisaka ve tii na 1818.

src: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti
trg: Insi ya Saint Domingue kele insi ina kele na Caraibe ina ke ya kuyalangana tii na kibuku ya ndambu ya este ya ntoto ya Espagne, wapi ntoto ke kabwanaka na Haiti.

src: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.
trg: Katula makumu ya djelo ya mpembe mpi bambonokono ya ngumba, insi kele kisika ya kuzinga ya mbanza ya ntama ntama ya Europa na Amerika, bubu yayi mosi ya Distrike ya Santo Domingo.

src: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.
trg: Ba Tainos mpi Ba Caribe vandaka bantu ya ntete ya kuzinga na kisanga yango. Ba caribe kuvandaka bantu ya ke tuba Arawakan yai ya kumaka mfinama na mvu 10,000 na Ntwala ya ya Lubutuku ya Klisto.

src: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors
trg: Na nima ya bamvula fioti ya kukuma ya bifimpi bwala ya bantu ya europa, bantu ya Tainos kulukaka mingi na ntalu na basodani yuinsi ya Espagne.

src: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
trg: Na kutalaka Fray Bartolomé ya Las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) na 1492 ti 1498, bantu ya Espani kuvandaka Bataínos kuluta 100 000.

src: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.
trg: Jardín de la Unión kele kisika yina tungamaka mutindu inzo ya bisadi ya Nzambi ya bakento, na nganda ya inzo ya ntinu na Senturi 17, kati na yo kele Tempelo ya San Diego ntunga yina mosi kaka bikisamaka.

src: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.
trg: Yo kele salama sesepi bonso kisika ya plaza ya kati, mpi mbala mingi yoke na bima mingi ke kusalama, mpimpa ti mwini.

src: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.
trg: Banzo ya kudila kele ya mingi fioti na distrike ya jardin, mpi na nima ya midi mpi na bankokila bo ke bulaka concert ya ofele na gaebo ya katikati.

src: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.
trg: Callejon del Beso (kukwenda ya bizu). Baetage zole ya ke kabwana kaka na basantimetre 69 kele inzo ya ntama ya kinsamu ya kuzola nkento to bakala.

src: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.
trg: Na mwa mbongo ya fioti bana ta tela nge disolo.

src: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.
trg: Kisanga ya Bowen kele kutambula ya kilumbu to nsuka ya mposo bantu kezonaka mingi ya kupesa kayak, kutambula, ya butiki, ya barestora, ti ya nkaka.

src: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.
trg: Kimvuka ya bantu ya bwala yina kibeni ke vandaka na Howe Sound kaka na mupanzi ya Vancouver, mpi bo ke kumaka kuna na nzila ya taxi ya masa yina ya bo manaka me zabana kukatuka na kisanga ya Grandville na ville ya Vancouver.

src: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.
trg: Na ba yina ke yangalalaka na bisalu ya nganda, kuzieta na nsamba ya Mbu na Yulu kele mfunu ngolo.

src: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.
trg: Whistler (nawola mosi ti ndambu ya kutambula na Vancouver) yo kele ntalu kansi yo me zabana sambu na nsaka ya Olympiques ya hiver ya 2010.

src: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.
trg: Na ntangu ya madidi, nge fwana kusielumuka na zulu ya matadi ya madidi na America ya Norde, mpi na ntangu ya mwini ya ngolo meka ku tambula na velo na ngumba.

src: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.
trg: Mukanda ya nswa fwete bumbama na ntwala. Nge fwete vanda na mukanda ya nswa sambu na kulala mpimpa mosi na Sirena.

src: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.
trg: Sirena kele mosi ya bisika ya sinzidi ya ke pesaka bisika ya kulala mpi madia ya tiya na zulu ya bisika ya Camp. La Leona, San Pedrillo, mpi Los Patos ke pesaka kaka bisika ya camp kukonda madia.

src: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards
trg: Muntu lenda kusumba banswa ya parke kuna kaka na kisika ya Ranger na Puerto Jimenez, kansi bo ndimaka mfutulu na bikalati ve.

src: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.
trg: Bisalu ya Park (MINAE) ke pesaka nswa ya park ve ngonda mosi kuluta na ntwala ya kukuma.

src: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.
trg: CafeNet El Sol kepesa kisalu ya kubumbila na kufutisa mbongo ya 30 $ dolar, to 10 $ sambu na kuluta ya kilumbu mosi; nsambu mingi na zulu ya dititi na bo Corcovado.

src: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.
trg: Bisanga ya Cook kele kisanga ya insi na kuwakana ya mpamba na kimvuka na Nouvelle Zelande, yai ya kele na Polynesie, na katikati ya Mbu ya Pacifique du Sud.

src: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.
trg: Yo kele kimvuka ya bisanga 15 ya insi ya kati ya masa ya ke kuyalangana na ba milio 2.2 ya ba km2 ya osean.

src: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".
trg: Kuvandaka na fuseau horaire mosi yai ti Hawaï, bisanga ke monanaka mbala nkaka bonso "Hawaï na insi".

src: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.
trg: Ata yo kuvanda fioti kuluta, yo ke yibuka ndambu ya bambuta mingi ya kwisaka kutala Hawii na ntwala yo kukuma insi ya luyalu nkatu ba hotel ya minene mpi ntombwama ya nkaka.

src: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.
trg: Bisanga ya Cook yo ke vandaka ti mbanza ve kansi yo kele ti bisanga 15 ya kuswaswana. Ya mfunu kele Rarotonga ti Aitutaki.

src: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.
trg: Bubu, na babwala ya insi ya bamvwama, kupesa bisika ya kudia nsuka na kulala me kuma mpilamosi na kisalu ya ntoko.

src: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.
trg: Na zulu na yonso, B&Bs ke nwanina na bima zole ya mfunu kuluta: Kulala mpi Kudia na suka suka.

src: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.
trg: Yo yina, na bisika ya kitoko ya mutindu yai, nge lenda kuta badrap ya ntalu mingi, mbala ya nkaka drap ya bo me sala na maboko to drap ya insi ntama .

src: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.
trg: Madia ya suka lenda vanda ti bima ya kitoko ya nsungi ya kisika yina to madia yina munkwa-nzo ke zolaka.

src: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.
trg: Kisika lenda vanda nzo ya nene ya ntama na bisadilu ya ntama, ntoto ya bunkete na kizinga ya kuyobidila.

src: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.
trg: Kukota na voiture na nge mosi mpi kukwenda na vwayaje ya ntama kele mbote.

src: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.
trg: Mutindu bakamio ya nene, nge fwete zaba mbote-mbote kunata kamio ya nge na zaba mpi bandilu na yo.

src: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.
trg: Kutedimisa nzo ya lele na lupangu ya muntu to na kati ya mbanza ya konso kuyalangana lenda kupenda meso ya bantu.

src: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".
trg: Na bunkufi, kusadila kamio na nge kele dibanza ya mbote kuluta sambu na nzietelo kansi yo kele mpasi yo kuvanda na yo mosi mpila ya ku "campe".

src: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.
trg: Kutambula na kamio kele mbote kana beno kele na fourgonette, SUV, mosi ya berline to break ti bakiti ya kutandama.

src: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.
trg: Ba hotele ya nkaka kele na difwafwa ya ntangu ya wolo yamasini ya muku ya nlai na maswa ya nene ya nzila ya masa ya mungwa yo bantikaka na siekele 19 to na mbatukulu ya siekele 20.

src: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.
trg: banzo yayi ya mvundulu ya ba mvwama mpi bantu ya kuzabakana vandaka na vandaka kudya mbote mpi kulutisa ba pimpa ya mbote.

src: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.
trg: Ndwatulu ya ntama ya mbote, konda kubaka bima yampa, mpi mpila ya kununa ya mbote kele mpi ndambu ya bifu na Bo.

src: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.
trg: Peleko bo kele mvwilu ya Bot mosis-mosi, bo ke ku talaka mbote na ku bumina bamfumu ya bwala na ba ntumwa ya bwala.

src: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.
trg: Muntu ya ke sala nzietelo yina ke na kiteso ya mbongo mingi lenda zieta na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, na lenda zinga na banzo ya mvundulu ya bamvwama.

src: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.
trg: Rezo ya kuyamba banzenza, kele kikunku yina ke vukisaka bantu ya ke sala nzietelo na bantu ya bwala yina kele kisika bo ke kumina.

src: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.
trg: Kukota na rezo ya mpila yayi, mingi-mingi kelombaka kusonika na mukanda na internete; Ata barezo ya nkaka ke lombaka nde bo tala mambu na nge ntete mbote mbote.

src: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.
trg: Mazina ya biyambi ya banzenza ke tulwaka na mikanda mpi na internet, bantangu ya nkaka na ba adelesi ya bo na ke tangwaka na bantu ya ke sala nzietelo ya nkaka.

src: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.
trg: Couchsurfing kusalamaka na ngonda ya Yanuari 2004 na nima ya programmeur mosi ya informatique Casey Fenton kuzw avion mosi na ntalu ya mbote sambu na kukwenda na Icelande kansi yandi vandaka na kisika ya kubikala ve.

src: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.
trg: Yandi sonikilaka balongoki ya universite ya malongi ya inda ya bwala, na yandi kutambulaka na nima, mikanda mingi ina vandaka kusonga bifulu mingi ya kuladila konda kufuta mbongo ina bantu kubikilaka yandi.

src: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.
trg: banzo ya mvundulu me salama ntete sambu na bantuenia-Kizingi ya kisika yina ke na bamvula makumi tatu - kansi nge lenda mpi kutala na kati bantu ya ke sala nzietelo ya bamvula mingi.

src: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.
trg: Bibuti ya kele ti bana ke monanaka mingi ve, kansi bisika ya nkaka ya banzo ke pesaka bo nzila na masuku sambu na bo mosi.

src: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.
trg: Mbanza ya Pékin na Chine yo ta vanda mbanza mosi ya lukumu ya bansaka ya Jeux Olympiques ya hiver ya 2022, yai ta sala yo mbanza mosi ya ntete ya kuyamba bansaka ya Jeux Olympiques ya ntangu ya Mwini mpi ya Madidi.

src: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.
trg: Beijing tayamba kukangula ya bansaka ti kukanga ya milulu na nsaka ya glace na kibanzala ya kati ya inzo.

src: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.
trg: Bansaka ya nkaka ya ski ta salama na kisika ya ski ya Taizicheng na Zhangjiakou, yina kele kiteso ya bakilometre 220 (140 miles) katuka na Beijing.

src: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.
trg: Batempelo mingi kuluta kele na kilumbu ya kuyangalala na mvula kubanda na nsuka ya ngonda ya Novemba tii na Katikati ya ngonda ya Mai ya ke sobana na kutala manaka ya tempelo mosi mosi.

src: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.
trg: Bankinsi mingi ya tempelo ke salamaka na mpila ya aniversere ya tempelo to ya aniversere ya nzambi yai ya ke twadisaka to ya nkinsi ya nkaka ya nene me kangama na tempelo.

src: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.
trg: Bankinzi ya tempelo ya Kerala ke vandaka kiese mingi na kutala, yo ke vandaka na kutambula ya banzoku yai bo me bongisa mbote-mbote, bantu ya ke mbilaka na tempelo, mpi bankinzi ya nkaka.

src: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
trg: Manaka ya kutadisa bima na meso ya bantu yonso (me zabana na zina ya Exposition Mondiale to Expo) ke mukembo ya ba insi yonso na kusonga bizizi mpi kuzaba ya konso kima.

src: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
trg: Babwala kesalaka baexposition ya artistique ti ya kubokula na kati ya bapavillons nationaux sambu na kusonga makambu ya mokili to ya culture ti ya histoire ya bwala na bo.

src: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
trg: Manaka ya nene ya nsi-ntoto ya kukuna bifulu sala mukembo kuma mbote na bulakisi bifuani ya bifulu, ntoto ya bifulu mpi konso kima yima me tala bifulu.

src: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.
trg: Na kuwakana ba lenda kuzua kisika konso mvula (kaka na ntangu yina ba kezingaka ya ba insi ya luswaswanu), na bansadilu bo ke salaka ve.

src: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
trg: Makambu yayi kusalaka bangonda tatu ti sambanu mpi yosalamaka na bisika ya 50 hectares.

src: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.
trg: Kele na mitindu mingi ya cinema yai ya bo ke sadilaka mvula na mvula. Film ya standard ya 35 mm (negatif ya 36 na 24 mm) ke yina ya ke monana na bantu yonso.

src: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.
trg: Yo lenda pesama na mutindu ya kulunga na pete kana yo me konda nge ; mpi kupesa nzila ya kuyidika mfinama na kumeka na DSLR ya sesepi.

src: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.
trg: Kisadilu kikangi bizizi lenda kubasisa bizizi ya yinda mingi ve ke sadilaka format ya 6 na 6 cm na ludelede 56 na 56 mm ya bukento.

src: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
trg: Yo ke pesaka nene yina me luta mbala iya nene ya negatif ya 35 mm (3136 mm2 contre 864).

src: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.
trg: Bambisi ya mfinda ke na kati ya bima ke vandaka bizizi ya mpasi samuna kubaka na kibaki ya bizizi, buna yo ke sosaka kibaki ya bizizi fwana kuvanda na buesso, luvibudulu, mvula mingi na kisalu na bisadilu ya mbote.

src: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.
trg: Bizizi na mfinda me bakamaka nkina kima ya mpai ve, kansi kubaka bizizi zola kusonga ti kizizi kele na kimvwama ya difunda mosi ya ngogo.

src: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.
trg: Kukanga foto ya bambisi ya zamba mbala mingi ke lombaka matala-tala ya kutadila na ntama Ata bima bonso bizizi ya kimvuka ya bandeke to kivangwa ya fioti mingi-mingi ke kulombaka kisalulu ya matala-tala ya mutindu ya nkaka.

src: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.
trg: Bambisi mingi ya nzenza ke vandaka mpasi na kumona, mpi baparke mbala mingi ke vandaka na bansiku ina me tala kubaka bafoto sambu na kutekisa yo.

src: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
trg: Bambisi ya mfinda lenda vanda nsoni-nsoni to ngansi-ngansi. Kisika bo ke zingaka lenda vanda madidi, tiya, to imbi kibeni.

src: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
trg: Bandinga 5000 kele na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, kubwela kulutila binzonzi ndinga makumi zole ti makumi tanu ya ba milio.

src: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.
trg: Ba ngogo yina Bo me kusonika ke vandaka mpasi ve na kubakula yo. Ya kele mpasi na kutanga mazina ya bifulu ya nkaka ya kuvandila.

src: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.
trg: Bantu ya bansi mingi ya mvimba ke tubaka Angele mbote, mpi na kuluta mingi nge lenda kumona bayina ya kuzaba fioti mingi mingi na kati ya baleke.

src: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.
trg: Yindula nde, kana nge vanda, na muntu ya Mancunia, Bostonia, Jamaica mpi ya ngambu ya Sidney kuvanda na nziunga ya mesa kudia na nkokila na restaurant mosi ya Toronto.

src: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.
trg: Bo ke yangalalaka na kutubaka binsamu ya bwala, yina bantu ya Distrike ya bo ke tubaka na mutindu ya kuzonzila mpi na ndinga ya bwala ya bo mosi.

src: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.
trg: Kusumba madia na ba supermarchés kele mbala mingi nzila ya kusumba na ntalu ya fioti sambu na kudia. Na kukonda mambote ya kikuku, kusola kele na limite na madia ya kikuku.

src: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.
trg: Mbala na mbala, ba supermarché ke pesaka bima mpila na mpila ya madia ya kikuku. Bankaka kepesaka ata four ya micro-ondes to bampila ya nkaka ya kuyamuna madia.

src: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.
trg: Na ba insi ya nkaka to na mutindu ya magasin ya nkaka, kele na restaurant mosi ya kisika yina, mbala mingi ya kuzabana na leta ve na bantalu ya mbote.

src: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
trg: Tala zaba kusala mpi kunata bakopi ya bansiku mpi banimelo mpi addresi assureur na nge ti nge.

src: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
trg: Bo fwana kusonga kisonokono na zina ya "email" mpi singa ya alo alo ya inzo ya kifuti bantu kana mambu ya mpasi me kukumina bo, sambu na malongi/bamuswa mpi kusala bandombolo.

src: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
trg: Bumba mukanda ya nkaka na nkutu ya nge na na internet (kusonika mukanda na nge mosi na ku bwela mukanda to kubumba na "cloud").

src: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
trg: Kana nge me kwenda mobembo ti ordinateur portable to tablette, bumba kopie mosi na kati ya memoire nayo to na disk (ya kukota kana Internet kele ve).

src: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
trg: Pesa mpi diaka bakopi ya politiki / ya banimelo na banduku ya voyage ti na babuti to na banduku ya bwala yayi kele na luzolo ya kusadisa beno.

src: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.
trg: Mbisi me kuzabana na zina ya orignal (kibulu ya mampoka) kele na miangu mingi ve kansi kana yandi me kunwanuswa yandi ke kunwana mpe.

src: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.
trg: Ntangu bantu ke mona ve kigonsa ya mbambi, bo lenda kupusana penepene mpi kuditula bo mosi na kigonsa.

src: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
trg: Beno nwa malafu ya kulawuka malembe. Alcool ke salaka na nitu ya bantu yonso mpila mosi ve mpi yo kele mfunu mingi na kuzaba ndilu na nge.

src: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.
trg: Kuvanda na mavimpi ya mbote ntangu ya yinda na nwinu Malafu ke bebisaka nitu mpi ke fwaka misu na kenataka mpi na lufwa. Mambu ya mpasi ke kumaka ngolo kana nge ke na kunwa Malafu ya ngolo.

src: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
trg: Malafu yina luyalu yiminaka lenda kuvanda na bima ya mbi yina lenda bebisa nitu ya muntu bake bingaka metanole, yo lenda kufwa meso to kunata na lufwa ata na kunwa ya ba doze fyoti fyoti.

src: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.
trg: Bineti lendaa vanda ntalu na insi ya nzenza, mingi na ba insi ya kimvwama ya fioti kisitu difuta na kisalu kele fioti.

src: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
trg: Beno kanina kusala ezame ya meso na nzo, mingi mingi kana yokele na kati ya assurance, mpi beno nata ordonance ya kupesa kisika ya nkaka.

src: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.
trg: Bisika ya bima ya ntalu mingi yai kele na ba région lenda vanda na mambu zole; ya nkaka lenda vanda kusadila na mpila ya mbote ve, ti bima ya nakka ya bwala banzena lenda vanda ntalu mingi kuluta na bwala na beto.

src: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.
trg: Kafe kele mosi na bima ke tekamaka mingi na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, na nge lenda kuzua ya mutindu na mutindu na bwala ya nge.

src: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.
trg: Kansi, mutindu ya kunwa café kele kuswanikisa na ntoto ya mvimba yo kele mfunu ya kumeka.

src: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.
trg: Canyoning kele kukwenda na nsuka ya bwatu yina kele na masa to mpi ve.

src: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
trg: Na kusala nsaka na Canyoning na masa, sadila mambu ya kutsab, kuyuluka, kudumuzuka--ke sosaka nge sala bangalasisi mingi to kuvanda na nitu na golo tekila nge kubanda (kufwanikisa na ditadi ke na kuyuluka, kusala skii).

src: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
trg: Kukwenda tambula kele kisalu ya nganda ya nzo, yo ke lombama kutambila na bisika ya kitini ya me tiungama na muntu ve, mingi mingi na nzila ya mfinda.

src: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
trg: Kutambula ya kilumbu yokele sambu na nda ya mile tiii na nda ya ntama yayi lenda vanda ya kutambula na kilumbu mosi.

src: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
trg: Sambu na kilumbu mosi ya kutambula na nzila ya pete, na kuzamba nzila kele na ntwala kele mpi muntu nyoso yayi kele mbote lenda sadila yo.

src: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
trg: Makanda kele na bana ya fyoti fwana kukubama bote, kansi Bo lenda kuvanda na nganda Ata Bo ke na bana ya fyoti na bana ke longukaka na universite ya bana.

src: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
trg: Na kutala na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, yo kele na Bikunku 200 ke kusalaka. Mingi kati na bo ke salaka bo mosi.

src: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.
trg: Kinungi ya mpa ya Bansaka ya Nene ya Kukima, kwendaka kuzungana bansinga ya nkangala bomi mbala kumi na zole yina kubukwaka na bikunku iya ya ntoto.

src: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.
trg: Sambu kisina ya Bansaka ya Ntinu ya Barcelone ke vandaka na Barcelone mpi ya bansaka ya Ntinu ya Copenhague ke vandaka na Copenhague, bansaka ya Ntinu ya Prague ina kele na Prague mpi bansaka ya nkaka landaka yo nswalu.

src: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
trg: Beno fwete toma zaba mambu mingi na ntwala mpi ntangu beno ke sala nzietelo na kisika mosi.

src: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
trg: Ntangu beno kele kwenda na voyage, beno vingila nde bima kuvanda ve bonso "kuvutuka na nzo". Bifu, bansiku, madia, kutambula, kuvanda, ba mpila, ndinga ti bima nkaka kele mpila mosi ve na bisika yayi beno ke vandaka.

src: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
trg: Yayi kele dyambu yina nge fwete zaba mbote mbote, na kulwadisa ntima ve to Kuyina banzila ya kusadila mambu yina ya me zabakana.

src: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.
trg: Ba agences ya voyages kele kubanda 19ème siècle. Muntu ya kisalu ya ba voyage kele kima mosi ya mbote sambu na voyage ya ntama ya kuzaba, kibumuntu, culture, ndinga to ba bwala yai kele na mbongo fioti.

src: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.
trg: Peleko banzo biteki batike mingi ke kubikaka mpi bifulu sambu na nzietelo, bisadi mingi ke na bisalu ya luswaswanu na yina me tadila mambu ya nzietelo, mutindu Ntalu ya mbongo me fwetekana to kisika ya kukumina.

src: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.
trg: Yo lenda mbote mingi kuluta kusadila kaka muntu ke kangilaka nge kisika ya nzietelo ya mutindu mosi mbala na mbala.

src: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
trg: Losa disu na wapi mutindu ya banzietelo bisadi me kukulula ntalu, ya vanda na site web to na ba fenetele ya ba nzo ba ke tekaka batike.

src: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.
trg: Kana nge ke zola kumona insi-ntoto na ntalu fioti, mpila nge me zola, luzingu to kumeka, kele ti mitindu mingi ya kusala yo.

src: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.
trg: Na yonso, yo ke kabwana na mitindu zole: To kusala ntangu ya nge ke na nzietelo, to nge meka kutula nsuka na kubasisa mbongo. mukanda yai ke tala diambu yai ya nima.

src: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.
trg: Sambu na byina ya ke zola kupesa makabu ya mambote, ya ntangu mpi yina ya bo lenda mona na ntwala sambu na kukitisa ntalu ya mbongo ya kubasisa pene na nkatu, tala mbongo ya fioti nyinso ya kubasika sambu na nzietelo.

src: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.
trg: Malongi me kutuba ti bantu ya ke sala nzietelo fwana ku laba ve, kuluta ve konda muswa, ku baka kisika ve na kutekisa ya mayuya, kulomba, to ku baka babima ya bantu na mayuya mpi kukumisa yo ya bo mosi.

src: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.
trg: Kisika ya kusadila kontrole na imigrasion kele mingi mingi kutelema ya ntwala na ntangu ya kukota na avion, na maswa to na voiture ya nkaka.

src: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.
trg: Na bandilu ya ba insi na kati ya masini ntalulu ya passeport ke kusalamaka na ntangu ina masini ke na kutambula na nge fawana vanda na Mukanda ya nzietelo ya kudelakana kana nge kele na ku sala ndietolo na masini ya mutindu yina.

src: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.
trg: Na nkokila biladi mpongi na masini, Passeport ke lombamaka ka kinati masini na yina nge ke kwamuswa ve na mpongi ya nge.

src: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.
trg: Kusonika ti kuzaba bumuntu, yo kele bima bokelombaka sambu na kubaka viza. Na bawala ya nkaka, nge fwete monisa bumuntu na nge ti kisika nge ke vandaka ti banfumu na nge.

src: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.
trg: Yo ke lomba nge kufulusa mukanda ya ba pupulu ya bwala to kubumina Biro ke talaka mambu ya nzietelo ya ba insi ya nzena.

src: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).
trg: Bansi mingi ya kele na bansiku mutindu yina, ba hotels ya bwala yina ta baka kisalu ya kusonikisa (kuvila ve na kuyuvula).

src: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.
trg: Na lweka ya nkaka, kaka ba yina ke vandaka na nganda ya mvundulu ya bantu ya ke sala nzietelo ba lenda kusonika mazina. Yo ke sala ti nsiku kusansumuna mbote mbote ve, na yina ya kele mbote na kutala mabu ke na kuiza nantwala.

src: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.
trg: Mayele ya kutunga banzo ke tadila kusala baplan mpi kutunga banzo. Mbala mingi, mayele ya kutunga ya kisika mosi buna ke bandaka bantu ya ke kwisa kutala ba insi ya banzenza.

src: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.
trg: Banzo ya yinda kele kitoko na kutala, na mweno ya banzo ya kulutila yinda mingi, kana nge me kutelema na fenetele ya nge lenda kuvanda kitoko mingi.

src: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.
trg: Architecture kevukisaka kukubika bisalu ya bambanza, kuyidika ba nzo, tinta ya bisalu, pumpala ya kati na kitoko ya ntoto.

src: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.
trg: Sambu bapueblos kele ntama kibeni, nge ta kuka ve kumonda bima mingi ya mpimpa kana nge sala ve nzietelo na nziunga ya Albuquerque to na Santa Fe.

src: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).
trg: Kansi, bacasino yonso ya me tangamaka awa na zulu ke pesaka malafu mpi mingi kati na yo ke pesaka mpila ya kulutisa ntangu ya mbote (mingi mingi ya nene yai vandaka pene-pene ya Albuquerque ti Santa Fe).

src: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.
trg: Beno zaba mbote: ba bars ya ba siti ya fioti kele ntangu yonso ve bisika ya mbote sambu na banzenza ya ke katuka ba insi ya nkaka na kwisa kusakana.

src: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.
trg: Nouvelle Mexico ya norde, kele na mambu ya nene na yina me tadila kunata kamio na yisi ya nwinu ya Malafu, na binati kamio yina ne nwaka Malafu kele na kiteso ya yinda na bifulu ya banganda ya bwala.

src: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.
trg: Bisono ya bo ke zola ve yina bo me sonika na bibaka, bo ke bingaka yo graffitis.

src: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.
trg: Ntangu ya kele ya kutatuka na kifwani, bantu mingi ke tulaka yo kintwadi na bantwenya yina ke bebisaka bima ya luyalu mpi ya bamvwama na kuzadilaka kipombi petile.
