src: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.
trg: Kansi, bubu yai, kele ti ba graffeurs ya me zabanaka, bafete ya ba graffitis mpi bibaka ya "nsiku ke ndimaka." Ba graffitis na mutindu yai me fwanana mingi ti bisalu ya art kansi ve na bima ya ke monana.

src: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.
trg: Kuvutula kima kisika yo ke katuka kele mayele ya bantu mingi ke vandaka ti yo yina bantu ya ke kwendaka kutala babwala fwete vanda ti yo.

src: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.
trg: Kana nge ke zola kulonguka mutindu ya kulosa kima ya ke kwisa kuvutuka na diboko na nge, nge fwete vanda na boomerang ya mbote ya kuvutuka.

src: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy
trg: Mingi ya bamambu bana ya Australie ke salaka ne vutukilaka bo bame binga yo boomerangs. yo kele mbote na ba yina ke na kubanda kusala kima sosa kukota ve na yo.

src: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.
trg: Madia ya Hangi ke lambama na dibulu ya tia na ntoto.

src: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.
trg: Dibulu ke kuma tia na matadi ya tiya ya me katuka na tiya, to tiya ya bisika ya nkaka ke salaka nde bisika yango kuvanda na tiya.

src: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.
trg: Bo ke sadilaka mbala mingi hangi sambu na kulamba madia ya bo me kalinga na mutindu ya ntama.

src: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.
trg: Bisika mingi na Rotorua ke pesaka bahangi géothermique, kansi bisika ya nkaka yolenda vanda bonso eglize ya Christchurch, Wellington ti ya nkaka.

src: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).
trg: MetroRail kele na baklasse zole na batrain ya banlieue na kati ti nzinga nzinga ya Cap Town: MetroPlus (mpi na zina ya First Class) ti Metro (na zina ya Third Class).

src: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.
trg: Masini ya ntinu mingi na zina ya MetroPlus kele mbote mpi na ke vandaka na bantu mingi ve kansi kele ntalu mingi Ata tiki ya masini ya bantu yonso kele ntalu mingi ve na eropa.

src: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.
trg: Konso masini ke na yonso zole ba ntwadisi ya MetroPlus na yina ya Metro; ba ntwadisi ya MetroPlus ke vandaka na nsuka ya masini pene na Cape Town.

src: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.
trg: Ntangu ya nge ke natila bantu ya nkaka -Kubika ve kutanina saki na nge, mingi mingi ntangu ya nge ke sabuka ndilu ya insi ya nkaka.

src: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.
trg: Nge lenda kudimona nde bo me sadila nge muntu ya kele nata drogue nkatu kuzaba, diambu ya tula nge na kati ya mpasi ya nene.

src: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.
trg: yo zola kuwakana kuvingila, sambu ba lenda kusadila nkisi ya bayimbwa kodwa kuvanda na olodonase.

src: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.
trg: Babwala ya nkaka ke pesaka ndola ya mpasi kuluta mpenza, ata na mbi ya mbala ya ntete; bo lenda zenga nkanu ya boloko ya bamvula kuluta 10 to nkanu ya lufwa.

src: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.
trg: Saki ya bo me bika nkatu muntu kutala ke yina ya miyibi ke bakaka mpi yo ke bendaka dikebi ya bamfumu ya ke waka boma nde yo lenda vanda ti bombi.

src: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.
trg: Na nzo, na mfunu ya kubaka yayi na ngolo makambu ya bwala, mabaku ya mbote kele ya kubaka yo.

src: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.
trg: Kansi na bitini ya nkaka ya nsi, wapi Bambisi ya fioti-fioti me tungaka nzo na bo kele diambu ya mpa na nge, nge kele ntama ya kubwa na makambu.

src: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.
trg: mpi, na bakilima ya tiya ba bactérie ke yundukaka ntinu ntinu na ke zingaka mingi na nganda ya nitu.

src: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.
trg: Na kisadilu ya kuyidika mbuma ya loso ya Delhi Belly, kuloka ya Falao, kuvutula mbi ya Montezuma na bakundi ya bo.

src: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.
trg: Bonso sambu na mpasi ya kupema na kati ya ba climat ya madidi, makambu ya nsopo na kati ya ba climat ya ntangu kele mingi ti, na makambu mingi kele mutungisi kansi kigonsa kele kibeni ve.

src: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.
trg: Kana nge ke na kuzieta na insi ya nzenza ya kuzangama mbala ya ntete - to kisika na ntete ya nsi-ntoto ya mvimba-kuzimbana yo ve nke lenda ku buabana na mpasi ya kulongoka mutindu ya kuvandila ya mpa.

src: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.
trg: Mutindu mambu ya nzietelo ke yela na nsi-ntoto ke lutilaka bantu mingi ya mbote, ya me fwana ya ke salaka nzietelo, sambu bo lenda bansoba mingi ya fioti nswalu-nswalu.

src: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.
trg: Mingi na bilumbu yayi beto yi kele, ku lala na ba nzo ya mvundulu ya bumpala mpi kitoko ya Este, nge fwana kumesana na madia mpi mutindu ya kusadila ya bo.

src: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.
trg: Kulala ve na matela to na nzila na bizunga yina me zaba ve mbote mbote mutindu ya bambisi.

src: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.
trg: Kana nge ke kwenda kulala na nganda, nata mbeto ya nganda to mbeta ya nsinga ya kudiembika sambu na kutanina nge na banioka, bankutu mpi bima ya nkaka ya mutindu yina.

src: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.
trg: Fulusa nzo ya nge na cafe na suka mpi thé chamomile na nkokila sambu na kukandula nitu.

src: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.
trg: Ntangu ya nge kele na kupema, nge nge na ntangu ya kudisadisa mpi kubaka miniti ya nkaka ya kubasisa kima mosi ya kuluta kitoko.

src: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:
trg: Kana nge ke wa mpusa kuluta, baka dibaku ya kunwa jus to kusangisa mwa bima mingi na mutindu ya yaourt:

src: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.
trg: Ntangu ya nkaka beno tamona malafu mosi ya pete yai beno lenda bongisa sambu na madia na ntangu beno tavutuka na mpila na beno ya ntangu yonso.

src: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.
trg: Kana nge ke vandaka na bwala yina kele kifu ya kuwa Malafu mingi, kwenda na banganda to na banganda kele mwasi yina nge ke kotaka ve.

src: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.
trg: Sambu na bayai ke zabaka ve ndinga ya baminganga, bangogo kupesa kimbefo mpi kusamukila kele na ntendula ya mpila mosi ve.

src: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.
trg: Maladi ya ke sambukilaka kele maladi ina ke katukaka na mikrobe, ya mbandu virisi, bacterie, mikrobe to bima ya nkaka.

src: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
trg: kimbefo yina ke mwanganka keke kimbefo yina ke zwaka kana nge kele kintuadi na mutu yina me bakama na kimbefo.

src: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.
trg: Ba govenema mingi ke sosaka banzenza kota na bwala, to bantu ya bwala kubasika, na kuzwa vaccin sambu na ku bela kidi kidi ve.

src: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
trg: Mambu ya bo ke lombaka lenda soba mingi na kutadila bansi yina muontu ya ke sala nzietelo me kwendaka kutala to ke zola kukwenda.

src: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.
trg: Kisika mosi ya ngolo ya Charlotte, na Carolina ya nordi, kele nde yo kele na banzila mingi ya kitoko ya kupona sambu na ba familia.

src: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.
trg: Bantu yina ke zingaka na ba bwala ya nzenza mingi ketubaka ti mbwanunu ya mbote ya dikanda kele dyambu ya ntete yina ke nataka bo na bifulu yina na banzenza ke talaka ti mbanza kele mbote na kuyangalala na bana.

src: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.
trg: Na bamvula 20 ya me luta, ntalu ya banzila ya kupona ya me lunga na bana na Uptown Charlotte me mata na kuluta ngolo.

src: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.
trg: Na Charlotte ba makanda ke sadilaka mingi ba bakamio ya takisi ve, bo ke sadilaka yo na na ba mambu ya kaka.

src: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.
trg: Kunata bantu 2 kele kilo mingi, kitini yayi kele ntalu mingi.

src: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.
trg: Antarctique kele kisika mosi ya madidi na ntoto ti yo kele na kitini ya mvimba ya pôle Sud.

src: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.
trg: Kutambula ya tourisme ke vandaka ntalu mingi, yo ke lombaka kuvanda ti nitu ya mbote, mpi yo ke salamaka kaka na ntangu ya nsungi ya kisiuwu na ngonda ya kumi na mosi ti ngonda ya zole, mpi ke suka mingi na ntoto ya pembeni ya masa, na ba bisanga mpi Nzadi ya Ross.

src: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.
trg: Bisadi mingi na bankento ya bo ke zingaka kwaku na nsungi ya ntangu ya golo mpi tiya mingi na zina ya été na bifulu makumi iya na nana, kaka mwa ndambu fyoti ke bikanaka na nsungi yina madidi ke salaka mingi na zina ya hiver.

src: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.
trg: Kati na Altarctique kele na kisika na nene me kukangama na 2-3 kilometre ya matadi ya mpembe.

src: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
trg: Banzila ya zulu yoke kwendaka na ntoto, sambu na aipinisme to sambu na kukuma na pole, yayi kele na baze ya nene.

src: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.
trg: Pole Traverse ya Sude ( to Nzila) ke le na bakilometre 1600 banda na kisika ya McMurdo na mabundu ya Ross ti na Pole.

src: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.
trg: kele mvula ya mpembe/neige ya ngolo ti kusieta ya kufuluka bendele. Yo lenda tambula kaka na batracteur ya mbote, sambu na kunata bakamio ti petrole mpi ti bisadilu.

src: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
trg: kele na mutindu ya kutoma lemfuka ve, yo yina nzila fwete vanda na kubaluka mosi ya nda na bangumba ya transantarctique sambu na kukuma na ntoto ya nseke.

src: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.
trg: Kikuma ya kuluta mbalu ya bigonsa na nsungi ya madidi kele kusietumuka ya balabala, ya nzila ya bantu ya makulu mpi mingi mingi na kumata escaliers.

src: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.
trg: Na mwa fioti, nge ke na mfunu ya bima ya kulata na makulu ya kele na semele ya kulunga. Sapatu ya kisiwu ke sietumuka mingi mingi na glasi mpi na neige ata bottes ya nkaka ya nsungi ya mpio ya ngolo lenda lunga ve.

src: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.
trg: Modele fwete vanda ya mudindu ya kulunga, 5 mm (38 mm) to kuluta, mpi bisadilu fwete vanda mwa pete kuluta na temperature ya madidi.

src: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.
trg: Basapatu ya botte ya nkaka ke vandaka ti bansonso mpi bisadilu ya nkaka ya bansonso sambu na kubuya kusietumuna, yayi me salama sambu basapatu ti babotte mingi, sambu na batalon ti basemele na yo.

src: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
trg: Binkoso ya makulu kele na nsi mpi nene. Zelo, matadi to mungwa (mungwa ya kudila) kele mbala mingi ya panzana na ba balabala to banzila sambu na kubongisa ntambulu.

src: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.
trg: Kubwa ya matadi na ngumba kele kima ya imbi ve; nge lenda nunga bisika ya kukulumuka kaka mwa fioti, mpi bima yina ya kele ya kuluta ta kuma bonso kubwa ya matadi.

src: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.
trg: Diambu ya mpasi kele nde neige ke kangamaka, yo yina yo fwete ti bima yina ke sadisa yo na kukulumuka, mpi neige yina ke bwaka lenda basisa mpasi mingi.

src: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
trg: Bantangu ya nkaka Mukembo ya mbwilu matadi ya mpembe na ntangu ya madidi ya ba insi ya nzenza ke tadisaka mutindu ntangu ke bwisa matadi ya tiya, bantangu ya nkaka matadi ya mbembe ke kubwa mingi, bantangu ya nkaka mpi nsoba na ntoto, na nsoba ya muntu.

src: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.
trg: Kimbogila ya nene ketelamaka mpi kuzungana na ngolo ya mupepe ya malembe yina ke zunganaka na zulu na kati mpi na nganda.

src: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.
trg: bo fulaka kitembo ya nene (mingi ba mile 100 na 200 na ngunga mosi) na yo lendaka nanguna mbima ya kilo na mupepe, kunaka bo mutinsu bitembo ya kulutila ngole mpi nene.

src: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.
trg: Ba bandaka na bibasisi muisi ya tiya na ntangu ya mupepe ya ngolo, na yo me kuma "mipepe ya ngolo" kisika ba simbaka ntoto.

src: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.
trg: Kuvanda na VPN (réseau privé virtuel) na nge mosi kele mutindu ya mbote ya kununga mambu ya kusosa kukanga bansangu ya politiki mpi ya mumbongo.

src: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.
trg: bo ke na zulu ya Proxy Web na mambu mingi: bo ke nataka ba nsonokono ya internet yonso, kaka http ve.

src: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.
trg: Na kulanda nsiku bo ke pesaka nsinga ya interneti ya ntinu kuluta mpi kusala kisalu ya mbote. Bo ke ya kutula yo na bidimbu ya ntalu mpi mutindu ina mpasi na kusosa kuzaba mambu na yo.

src: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".
trg: Bakompani ya kupanza nsangu ke tuba luvunu na yina me tala kikuma ya mambu yai, kutubaka nde yo kele sambu kubuya bantu "kukota na sekele ya bantu".

src: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.
trg: Bacode ya Distrike kele na ngolo ve na kukanga ba copie luyalu me yimina, copie ya ndambu ndambu ya disque lenda me ku zonza mbote kulutila original ya disque.

src: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.
trg: Mfunu ya ntangu yai kele kupesa kompani luyalu na zulu ya bazandu na boyonso ya ke teka; yonso kele sambu mbongo kutambula.

src: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.
trg: Sambu bo ke nataka bansangu na nzila ya Internet, mfunu kele ve ya kusadila kompani ya telefone ina kele na kisika ya ke zingaka to ya nge ke sala nzietelo.

src: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.
trg: kele mpi na kima ya kufwete sala ete nge kuzwa nimelo katuka na kimvuka ya bantu wapi nge ke zinga; nge lenda kuzwa connexion ya interneti na nzila ya satellite na mutindu ya Chicken, Alaska mpi kupona nimelo ya ke songa nde nge ke na insi ya ntangu ya Arizona.

src: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
trg: Mbala mingi, nge fwete sumba nimero ya insi ya mvimba ya kukabwana yai ta pesa batelefone PSTN nswa ya kubinga nge. Kisika nimero me tuka ke vandaka mfunu mingi sambu na bantu yina ke binga.

src: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
trg: Kisadula ya kubalula bandinga-bisadilu ina lenda kubalula mambu na ndinga ya nkaka yo mosi lenda kubalula kikunku ya bisono na ndiga mosi tii na ndinga ya nkaka.

src: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
trg: Ba application ya nkaka ya mpila yai lenda kutu bongola mukanda na bandinga ya banzenza na zulu ya bidimbu to bima ya nkaka na kati ntoto ya mvimba na ntangu muntu kesadila me pona smartphone na bima yai.

src: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
trg: Kisadilu ya ku balula bansonoko na ndinga ya nkaka kumaka mbote mingi na yo salaka ti bubaludi bansonoko na ndinga nkaka vanda mbote (na bansonoko ya mbi), kansi kusala angele fwana kuvanda sambu ba ntangu ya nkaka yo ke pesaka bansonokono ya mbi.

src: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
trg: Mosi ya bisadilu ya mbote mingi ya mpila yayi kele Google Translate, yo kepesaka nzila na kubalula ndinga kukonda interneti na nima ya kubaka na internet bima ya mambu ya ndinga yina ya nge zola kubalula.

src: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.
trg: Kusadila application ya GPS sambu na kusonga nzila na telefone na yo lenda vanda nzila ya pete mpi ya kulunga kuluta sambu na kutambula ntangu nge kele na nganda ya insi na nge.

src: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.
trg: Yo lenda kubumba mbongona kisika ya kusumba carte ya mpa sambu na GPS mosi, to appareil ya GPS ya standard to kudefa mosi ya kompani ya kamio ya ke defisaka.

src: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.
trg: Kana nge kele ve na unite sambu na telefone na nge, to ntangu yo kele ntama na diboko, kusala na yo lenda kukonda to yo lenda monana ve.

src: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.
trg: Ba songi yonso kele ya kufuluka na ba kalate ya nsinga yina ba lenda sadila na nsinga ya komelese to na ba singa ya mpamba.

src: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.
trg: Kana bakalati mingi yokepesaka nzila na kubinga ata nki kisika, ya nkaka yokele sambu na kupesa bantalu ya kubinga mfunu na bimvuka ya babwala.

src: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.
trg: Na ku kota na baselevice yayi nge fwana binga nsinga alo alo konda mbongo.

src: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
trg: Misiku me tadila ku baka bizizi ke talaka mpi mutindu ya kubumba bizizi, mpi mambu mingi ya nkaka.

src: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
trg: Kana muswa me pesama na kuzwa bizizi, nge lenda ata kuyindula ve ku bumba bizizi ya bo.

src: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
trg: Kana beno kele kusadila drone, beno tala mbote kana beno mepesama nswa na ntwala ya kufilme mpi nki mukanda to lisanse yayi kele mbote.

src: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
trg: Kupumbusa drone mfinama na nganda ya avion to na zulu ya kimvuka ya bantu mingi kele ntangu yonso libanza ya mbi, ata ke na yo me pesama nswa na distrike na nge.

src: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.
trg: Na kilumbu ya bubu sambu na kusala nzietelo na mupepe bantu ke na ku futa tike ve kana bo me kusosa ntete ve mpi kuswasikisa ba ntalu ya kufuta.

src: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.
trg: Ntangu ya nkaka avion kaka mosi yina lenda vanda na ntalu ya kuswaswana mpi bo ke futaka sambu na kumeka resultats mpi kutala na website ya avion yina mosi na ntwala ya kusala reservation.

src: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.
trg: Ntangu nge lenda ndima ve viza sambu na visite ya ntangu fioti na bansi ya nkaka bonso touriste to sambu na affaires, kukwenda kuna boso nlongoki ya insi ya nzenza ke lomba kubikala ntangu mingi kuluta visite ya mbala mosi bonso touriste.

src: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.
trg: Mingi mingi kuvanda na bwala ya nzenza ntangu ya nda yoke lombaka nge vanda ti viza.

src: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.
trg: Baviza ya bana ya nzo-nkanda mingi-mingi ke vandaka ti mambu ya kuswaswana ya bo ke lombaka mpi mutindu ya kuswaswana ya kulomba yo, na kutadila baviza ya bantu ke kwisa kutala bwala to ya mumbongo.

src: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.
trg: Na ba insi mingi, nge fuana kuzua mukanda ya universite ina nge zola kulonguka na mukanda ke kusonga kana nge ke na mbongo ya kulunga na kufuka mvula ya ntete ya universite nge mosi.

src: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
trg: Zikisa mambu mbote-mbote na bimvuka ya luyalu, mpi depatema ya Immigration sambu na insi wapi nge ke zola kulonguka na kubaka bansangu ya mingi kuluta.

src: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.
trg: Katula kaka kana nge kele ntumwa ya insi ya nkaka, to nge ke salaka na bwala ya nzenza yo ke zola tuba mingi mingi nde nge fwete lomba mpaku ya difuta na bwala ya nge ke vandaka.

src: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.
trg: Mpaku ya bo ke bakaka na salere me swaswana na bansi ya kuswaswana, mpi ntalu ya mpaku mpi mutindu ya kuzenga yo me swaswana mingi na kutadila konso insi.

src: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.
trg: Na nayinzi kele mvukani ya ba mbanza mingi mutindu Amerika na Canada, mpaku na mbongo yina muntu ke zwaka ke katukaka bisika zole na na kisika mbula matadi na bamfumu ya bwala, na kiteso mpi mbongo yina me ku tezwa kele ya luswaswanu na ba mbanza.

src: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.
trg: Na ntangu ina Bansosa ya ku zieta na insi ya nzenza kele mingi ve to kufulusa mikanda na kukota ya nge na bwala, Bansosa ya Birokoti mbongo lenda kupesa beno itu pasi.

src: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.
trg: Tala mbote nde nge zaba inki nge lenda sala/tuba to lrndave kutuba/kusala na kutuba bima ya kuluta banswa ya nsiku me pesa nge.

src: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.
trg: Nzila ya kuluta pete ya kuyantika kisalu ya kusonika mambu ya nzietelo kele kuvanda ti mayele ya kusonika blog ya ke tubila nzietelo.

src: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.
trg: Kana nge me kuma ti kusala formattage mpi kusala site internet, na nima, nge lenda sala site internet na nge mosi.

src: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.
trg: Kusala kisalu ya luzolo ya mbote ntangu nge ke sala nzietelo kele mutindu ya nene ya kusala luswaswanu kansi yo kele ve kaka kupesa.

src: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.
trg: Kuzinga na kusala kisalu konda kuzwa difuti na insi ya nzenza ke nzila ya mbote na ku bakula kintama ya luswaswanu, kuvukana na bantu, kuzaba bo, kuvanda na mpive kwenda na mantuala na ku bwela mpi ba nsadilu ya nkaka.

src: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.
trg: Yotalenda mpi vanda mpila mosi ya mbote ya kusala budget yo vanda nene sambu na kupesa nzila na kuvanda bilumbu mingi, sambu bisalu mingi ya mpamba yokepesaka bisika ya kuvanda ti pension ti bankaka kefutaka mwa mbongo ya nsuka ya ngonda.

src: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.
trg: basoda ya insi ya Scandinave sadilaka nzila ya masa ya batu ya Russie na kukuma na Imbu ya Ndombe na Imbu ya Caspienne. Bisika ya nkaka ya nzila yayi lenda mpi kusadulwa ti bubu yayi. Nge fuana sosa mukanda ya kingenga ya kulutila yo kele mpasi na kuzua.

src: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.
trg: Mubu ya Mpembe--Nzila ya Baltiki me kuvukisa Oseani ya Arctiki na Oseani ya Baltiki na nzila ya Dizanga Nene ya Onega, Dizanga Nene ya Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, mingi na banzadi mpi masanga nene.

src: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.
trg: Laki na zina ya Lake Onega kele mpi ya kuvukana na Voga, mpidina kukwisa katuka na Nzadi ya Caspian kuluta na nzila ya Russie lenda salama kaka.

src: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.
trg: Kuikila yo kana nge me simba maswa ya marinas mambu yonso ke vanda ya kuzabakana. Nge ke vukana bantu ke bwilaka maswa na bo ke kabula bansangu na nge.

src: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.
trg: Na bunkufi, nge ta tula bansangu ya ke monisa nde nge ke zola kusadisa, nge ta kwenda kutambula na dibungu, ta pusana pene-pene ya bantu ina ke yobisa maswa na bo, mpi ta sosa kusolula ti bantu ya ke salaka na maswa na bare, mpi buna na buna.

src: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.
trg: Meka kutuba na bantu mingi yayi nge lenda. Na nima ya mwa ntangu, bantu yonso t azaba nge mpi bo ta songa nge nki bantu nge fwete baka.

src: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.
trg: Nge fwete kusola mukanda ya bansangu ya nzietelo ya avio nabuku ya bansangu malembe.

src: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.
trg: Nge lenda tala ti ya kele mutindu kima ya kusakana to ya mbamya ya kukota kompani ya avio yina nge ke zieta na yo, zaba ti nzila yina me kupesama na nge kele ya luswaswanu na nzietelo lenda vanda mbote na na kompani ya luswaswanu na kintwadi mosi.

src: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.
trg: Bakompani ya Avion bonso Emirates, Ethiad Airways, Qatar Airways mpi Turkish Airways me panza bisalu na bo mingi na Afrika, mpi ke na baBiro ya kukwenda na site mingi ya nene ya Afrika na ntalu mosi ya mfunu kuluta kompani ya nkaka ya Europa/Mputu.

src: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.
trg: Turkish Airlines kezetaka na babwala 39 na insi 30 ya Afrika kubanda 2014.

src: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.
trg: Kana nge kele ti ntangu ya kusala diaka nzietelo, tala mbote sambu na kuzaba ntalu ya mbongo ya nge ta futa na Afrika kana nge fwanisa yo ti ntalu ya mbongo ya ntoto ya mvimba.

src: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.
trg: Vila ve na kuyika ntalu ya ta yikama na visa ya nkaka, mpaku ya kukwenda, transport, mpi ya nkaka nkaka sambu na bisika yina yonso na nganda ya Afrika ya Sudi.

src: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.
trg: Kana nge zola zieta na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba na Hemisphere ya sude, vote ya avio na bisika bo kekukuma kele na ndilu na konda ba nzila na zulu ya océan.

src: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).
trg: Ya ke na kompani ve ya avio ke kumaka tii na mubu ya nene ya Hemisphere ya sudi (na SkyTeam ke kumaka ve na bisika yayi).

src: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.
trg: Na yina, Star Alliance ke yalaka bima yonso katula Pacifique ya Banda ya esete na Santiago ya Chilie tii na Tahiti, bame binga avio ya LATAM Oneworld.

src: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)
trg: Avion yai kele nzila kaka mosi ve kana nge ke zola kukuma na Pacifiqiue ya Sudi mpi mukidi ya westi ya Amerika ya Sudi. (tala awa na nsi)

src: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.
trg: Na 1994, muntu ya dikanda ya Nagorno-Karabakh na Armenie, provense mosi ya Azerbaijan nwanaka bitumba na ba Azeris.

src: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.
trg: Na lusadisu ya Arménie, bo salaka insi ya mpa. Kansi, insi mosi ve ya me zabanaka - ata Arménie yo mosi - ke ndimaka insi yina.

src: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.
trg: Balukanu ya Mimonisi insi kati na bizunga ke na kutatamana kubebisa kuwakana kati na Armenie na Azerbaijan.

src: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.
trg: Distrike ya Canal (Na ndinga ya Allemand Grachtengordel) kele Distrike me kulutila mbote ya 17 ya ba yimvu makumi zole ke tanaka Distrike ya Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.

src: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.
trg: Distiliki ya mvimba ke bingama bonso Kisika ya Insi ya Mvimba na UNESCO sambu na bima ya kkuzingila mpi ya lisitwale na yo ya kele kaka na yo mosi, mpi bimvwama na yo ya ntalu kuluta na insi yina.

src: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.
trg: Cinque Terre, ke zotuba bantoto tanu, yo kele ti babwala tanu ya fioti ya zulu ya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza ti Monterosso yayi kele na région ya Italie ya Ligurie.

src: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
trg: Bo me sonikaka bazina na bo na mukanda ya bantu me yinga bima ya insi ya mvimba na UNESCO.

src: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
trg: Na nima ya nkama ya bamvula, bantu me kuyidika na ngemba yonso bisika ya kuvwandila mpi kupemisa nitu ya kutalana na meso ya bantu na me tadisa na mabundu ne ke pesa pumpala yonso ya mabundu.

src: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
trg: Mosi ya mbote na yandi kele kukonda kompani ya ke zabana polele. Banzila, batrain mpi na bamaswa ke tambulaka na banzila na babwala, bavoiture yo lenda kuzwa bo ve na nganda.

src: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.
trg: Bifwani ya Fwalansa ke tubamaka na Belgique na Suisse kele ya kuswaswana na yina ba ke tubaka ba Fwalansa ya insi ya Falanse, peleko yo kele ya kudedakana na kusolwa.

src: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.
trg: Yoyina, système ya numérotation na Belgique francophone ti na Suisse kepesaka bampila mosi ya pete yayi kesalaka kukesana ya kutuba Français na France, ti prononciation ya bandinga ya nkaka kele ya kukesana mwa fioti.

src: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.
trg: Na kutala, ba Français yonso ke tubaka ndinga ya ba ya baBelge na ya baSuisse longukaka Français na universite na yina bo ke kuwa nge mbot mbote kana nge ke na kuwakana Français mutindu bo.

src: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."
trg: Na bifulu mingi ya nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, kunanguka ya masa mutindu ya kinduku ke kusongaka kuwakana "mbote".

src: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.
trg: Yo yina, na Malaisie na Bwala ya Bamalezien na bisika na bo ya bwala, ndinga ke songa "kwisa" mpila mosi ti musapi ya zole na nitu, bokesadilaka yo mingi na babwala ya occidental, mpi yo fwete salama sambu na mfunu yina.

src: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.
trg: Mpila mosi, muntu ya Grande-Bretagne ya ke sala nzietelo na Espagne, yo lenda kuvilana ti vague adieu ya diboko na ntwala (kuluta muntu yayi bo kele kusonga) kidimbu ya kuvutuka.

src: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.
trg: Bandinga yayi me tulama kele bandinga artificielle to me salama sambu na kusala pete na disolo ya bantu ya nkaka yayi lenda vanda na mpasi ya kotuba.

src: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.
trg: Yo kele ya kukesana ti lingua francas, yayi kele bandinga ya bantu to yabaorganike yayi kekuma ngolo sambu na mfunu ya nkaka to na mpila bantu ya bandinga ya nkaka ke tubaka yo.

src: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).
trg: Na kati ya ntangu ya kilumbu, bantu ya banzietelo lenda tala bamirage yai kupesa ngindu ya masa (to makambu ya nkaka).

src: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.
trg: Yayi lenda vanda kigonsa kana muntu ya ke sala nzietelo ke landa miraje, na kuludisaka ntangu mpi na kubikala na masa.

src: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.
trg: Ata nsi makanga ya tiya kuluta lenda kuma madidi kuluta na mpimpa. Kufwa na madidi kele kigonsa kibeni na kukonda bilele ya tia.

src: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.
trg: Na nsungi ya kisiwu, nge ta vanda mingi mingi na mfunu ya kutina mbembele kana me baka lukanu ya kwenda tambula na mfina ya masa-masa.

src: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.
trg: Ata kana nge ke tambwisa kamio na bamfinda na nsi ya ntangu, kubika baporte ya kukangula mwa basekonde fioti ntangu nge ke kota na kati me fwana sambu bambembele kukota na kati ya kamio ti nge.

src: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.
trg: Kimbefo ya grippe ya bandeke, lenda kanga bandeke mpi bambisi ina ke nwisaka bana na bo mabele.

src: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.
trg: Makambu mingi kutadisamaka na bantu, kansi ya nkaka na kati na bo kuvandaka ya kufwa.

src: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.
trg: Mingi ke tadilaka bantu yina ke salaka ntoto ya tuma, kansi yo kele mpi ti mwa bigonsa sambu na bantu ina ke longukaka bandeke.

src: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.
trg: Bafjords yayi kutinaka mpi na mabengi yayi kupesaka nzila na plato ya nene ya mpila mosi ya Norvege.

src: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.
trg: Bifulu mingi ya ntota ke ya kulala ke na zina ya "vidde" yina zola kuwakana kisika banti kele ve, kisika ya nene konda nsukulu.

src: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.
trg: Na Rogaland na Agder, bo ke bingaka yo "hei", yina zola kuwakana ntoto yina ke na ba iti ve kansi kele ya ba iti fyoti fyoti mingi.

src: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.
trg: Baglace ke nikana-nikanaka, mpi yo ke kulumukaka na ngumba. Yo ke pusanaka, ke zenganaka, ebuna bapont ya neige lenda kanga yo nzila na kumonana.

src: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.
trg: Bibaka mpi baludi ya mabulu ya matadi ya madidi lenda kubwa mpi kupasuka lenda kangama.

src: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.
trg: Na bisika me zungidila matadi ya mpembe, matadi ya nene ya mpembe me pasuka, ke losoka ntama to kuvindumuka na kwenda ntama na matadi.

src: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.
trg: Ntangu ya mbote bibumini bifulu ya ngumba ke vandaka mingi na ntangu ya mini ya ngolo mpi ya tiya mingi ya insi ya Inde.

src: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.
trg: Na kutala, bo kele na kitoko ya luswaswanu mpi bumpala na ntangu ya madidi, na bisadula mingi na bangumba ke yambaka matadi kepesaka mavimbi ya mbote na kepesaka nzila na kutambula na matadi mpi kusala bansaka.

src: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.
trg: Bakompani fioti mpamba ya avion ke vandaka ti batike ya bantalu ya mafwa, yo ke kulumusaka ntalu fioti sambu na nzietelo ya ntinu-ntinu ya mafwa.

src: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.
trg: Ba avion yina ke pesaka yo kele Air Canada, Delta Airlines, Luthansa na banzietelo ke katuka na Amerika to Canada na Westjet.

src: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
trg: Na mpila yonso, beno fwete bumba mbala mosi kisika na nzila ya téléfone na kompani ya avion.
